items.title: 賴清德：目標2030起年均1千萬國外旅客來台 觀光產值朝破兆元邁進
items.title_en: Lai Ching-te: Goal of 10 Million International Visitors Annually Starting 2030, Tourism Output Aiming to Break the Trillion‑Dollar Mark
paras: 總統賴清德今 (31) 日出席「2026 年台灣美食展開幕典禮」時表示，美食展不僅能讓大家品嘗各地美食、認識台灣風俗民情，更是推動觀光發展及國際交流的重要平台，未來政府將持續串連美食、觀光步道及會展等多項元素，朝 2030 年起每年均 1 千萬人次國際旅客來台、觀光產值突破兆元的目標邁進，也歡迎國人把握機會前來觀展。
賴清德致詞表示，「台灣美食展」有幾項重要的意義：第一，民以食為天，不論是排灣族以動人悅耳的歌曲邀請大家一起吃飯，或是台灣人的日常問候「呷飽未」，若想了解各地的美食，最簡單的方式就是來到「台灣美食展」，不僅可以吃遍各地美食，也能認識台灣各地風俗民情。
第二，「台灣美食展」也是推動台灣觀光的重要策略之一，台灣以觀光立國，有美麗的地景、豐厚的文化及台灣最美的風景就是人，其中美食也是推動觀光產業的重要元素。去 (2025) 年外國來台灣光旅客近 860 萬人次，今年可望較去年增加，期盼在 2030 年達到每年 1 千萬人次國際旅客來台及觀光產值破兆元的目標。
至於美食展的第三個重要意義，賴清德認為，美食是交朋友非常好的方式，近期巴拉圭貝尼亞總統訪台，除了參訪台積電 (2330-TW) 外，也前往台南阿霞飯店品嚐在地台菜美食，不但吃得津津有味，也留下非常難忘的回憶。在國際重要領袖來台時，以台灣在地美食，庶民美食款待外賓也非常重要。
除了推動美食展外，賴清德也說，近期政府推出「縱走台灣 Twalk」，規劃 6 條觀光步道，吸引外國旅客來臺灣旅遊，希望未來能透過美食、縱走山林綠道等多元的旅遊體驗相互串連，達到吸引國際旅客來台的目標。
賴清德表示，未來政府積極推動美食會展與觀光產業結合，以最為人熟知的台北國際電腦展 (COMPUTEX) 為例，每年都有許多國際專業人士來到台灣，希望能將來台參展的專業人士轉化為觀光旅客，到各地品嘗美食、健走及體驗在地風土民情，這也是未來政府要持續努力的方向。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te said at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Taiwan Food Expo today (31) that the expo not only lets people taste foods from around the island and learn about Taiwanese customs, but also serves as an important platform for tourism development and international exchange. The government will continue to link food, hiking trails and conventions, aiming for 10 million international visitors each year from 2030 and tourism output exceeding a trillion dollars, and he invited citizens to take the opportunity to attend the expo.

In his speech Lai noted several key meanings of the Taiwan Food Expo. First, food is fundamental to people’s lives; whether it’s the Paiwan tribe inviting everyone to share a meal with moving songs or the everyday Taiwanese greeting “Have you eaten?”, the simplest way to learn about regional cuisines is to come to the Taiwan Food Expo, where you can sample dishes from across the island and get to know local customs.

Second, the expo is a major strategy for promoting Taiwan’s tourism. Taiwan builds its economy on tourism, boasting beautiful scenery, rich culture and, most importantly, its people, with food being a vital tourism element. In 2025, foreign visitors to Taiwan numbered nearly 8.6 million, and this year is expected to exceed last year’s figure, with the aim of reaching 10 million international visitors annually and tourism output surpassing a trillion dollars by 2030.

A third significance, Lai said, is that food is an excellent way to make friends. During the recent visit of Paraguay’s President Santiago Peña, he not only toured TSMC (2330‑TW) but also dined on local Taiwanese cuisine at the Ah‑Hsi Hotel in Tainan, enjoying the meal and creating lasting memories. Serving local, popular dishes to visiting world leaders is therefore very important.

Beyond the food expo, Lai mentioned the government’s newly launched “Twalk” initiative, which plans six tourism trails to attract foreign travelers to Taiwan. He hopes that by linking food experiences with mountain‑greenway hikes and other diverse tourism activities, the goal of drawing more international visitors can be achieved.

Lai said the government will actively integrate food exhibitions with the tourism industry. Using the well‑known Taipei Computer Exhibition (COMPUTEX) as an example, each year many international professionals come to Taiwan. The aim is to convert these participants into tourists who travel around the island to taste food, hike, and experience local culture, a direction the government will continue to pursue.

items.title: AI需求噴發推升獲利 鎧俠當季淨利暴增45倍
items.title_en: AI Demand Surge Boosts Profits, Armored Knight’s Quarterly Net Profit Surges 45‑Fold
paras: 日本半導體大廠鎧俠控股周五 (31 日) 公布 2026 會計年度第一季 (4 月至 6 月) 財務報告。受惠於全球 AI 資料中心 對記憶體零件的強勁需求，公司單季淨利較去年同期大幅成長超過 45 倍，顯示人工智慧浪潮正持續帶動快閃記憶體市場的回溫。

財務表現：獲利能力創歷史新高

根據財報數據，鎧俠該季淨利由去年同期的 183 億日元大幅躍升至 8,422 億日元。單季營收則來到 1.77 兆日元，較去年同期成長約 4 至 5 倍。在獲利指標方面，營業利益達到 1.27 兆日元 (Non-GAAP 基準為 1.33 兆日元)，年增率高達約 2,700%。
鎧俠指出，業績成長主要歸因於 NAND 快閃記憶體價格的上漲以及出貨量的增加。特別是在企業級固態硬碟 (Enterprise SSD) 領域，由於 AI 伺服器需求持續釋放，帶動此類產品單季營收創下歷史紀錄。儘管獲利數據驚人，但營收仍略低於部分市場分析師預期的 1.84 兆日元。

市場驅動力與產品技術進展

全球技術龍頭對 AI 基礎設施的投資熱潮，已將記憶體零件推向高價。鎧俠的核心產品 NAND 快閃記憶體因 AI 代理工具需要龐大存儲空間而成為熱門商品。
公司觀察到，全球 NAND 市場目前處於 供需緊繃 狀態，一方面是 AI 訓練對高容量硬碟的需求成長，另一方面則是各大記憶體廠在過去兩年嚴格控管資本支出，導致新產能釋放有限。
在技術研發上，鎧俠已開始交付第九代與第十代 BiCS FLASH 快閃記憶體晶片樣本，預計將應用於智慧型手機、個人電腦及伺服器。該公司表示，新款伺服器固態硬碟的讀取速度是早期版本的 8 倍以上，顯見在 AI 領域的技術布局。

未來展望與戰略布局

針對第二季 (7 月至 9 月) 的營運展望，鎧俠預估營收將進一步增至 2.39 兆日元，營業利益可望達到 1.89 兆至 1.9 兆日元。儘管此獲利指引略低於彭博社調查分析師預期的 1.95 兆日元，但公司預期 NAND 平均售價將持續上漲，支撐業績表現。
為了提升股東價值與資本效率，鎧俠宣布了一系列戰略舉措，包括：

股票分割：將於 2026 年 10 月 1 日執行 1 拆 3 的拆股計畫。
股份回購：計畫於 8 月至 10 月間回購最高達 8,000 億日元的庫藏股。
上市計畫：公司正研議於美國上市。


市場意見與股東結構變化

主要股東貝恩資本 (Bain Capital) 日本代表 Yuji Sugimoto 對公司前景表示樂觀，他認為：「雖然業務在短期內具有周期性，但從中長期來看，鎧俠的企業價值成長速度將超過 GDP 成長速度。」
目前東芝 (Toshiba) 已取代貝恩資本成為最大股東，持股約 15%。而南韓晶片大廠 SK 海力士則透過特殊目的公司間接持有約 14% 股份，其競爭與合作關係亦受到市場密切關注。
投資機構如野村證券 (Nomura) 則維持對鎧俠的「買進」評等，認為 AI 驅動的企業級儲存需求仍處於快速成長階段，NAND 價格上漲的力道可能持續超出市場預期。
paras_en: Japan’s major semiconductor firm Armored Knight Holdings announced its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2026 (April‑June) on Friday the 31st. Benefiting from strong global AI data‑center demand for memory components, the company’s quarterly net profit grew more than 45 times year‑over‑year, showing that the AI wave continues to warm the flash memory market.
Financial performance: Profitability hits a historic high

According to the report, Armored Knight’s net profit for the quarter jumped from ¥18.3 billion in the same period last year to ¥842.2 billion. Quarterly revenue reached ¥1.77 trillion, about four to five times the prior‑year level. Operating profit was ¥1.27 trillion (Non‑GAAP ¥1.33 trillion), a year‑over‑year increase of roughly 2,700%.

Armored Knight said the growth was mainly driven by higher NAND flash prices and increased shipments. In particular, the enterprise SSD segment set a record quarterly revenue as AI server demand kept expanding. Although the profit figures were spectacular, revenue was slightly below some analysts’ expectations of ¥1.84 trillion.
Market drivers and product technology advances

The global tech leaders’ rush to invest in AI infrastructure has pushed memory component prices higher. Armored Knight’s core product, NAND flash memory, has become a hot item because AI workloads require massive storage capacity.

The company observes that the worldwide NAND market is currently in a tight supply‑demand situation: on one hand, AI training drives up demand for high‑capacity drives; on the other, major memory makers have tightly controlled capex over the past two years, limiting new capacity releases.

In R&D, Armored Knight has begun shipping samples of its 9th‑ and 10th‑generation BiCS FLASH chips, expected to be used in smartphones, PCs and servers. The firm says the new server SSDs read more than eight times faster than earlier versions, underscoring its technical positioning in the AI arena.
Future outlook and strategic positioning

For the second quarter (July‑September), Armored Knight forecasts revenue of about ¥2.39 trillion and operating profit of ¥1.89‑¥1.90 trillion. While this profit guidance is a bit below Bloomberg analysts’ estimate of ¥1.95 trillion, the company expects average NAND selling prices to keep rising, supporting performance.

To enhance shareholder value and capital efficiency, Armored Knight announced several strategic measures: a 1‑for‑3 stock split to be executed on October 1 2026; a share‑buyback program of up to ¥800 billion planned for August‑October; and plans under consideration for a U.S. listing.
Market opinion and shareholder structure changes

Bain Capital’s Japan representative Yuji Sugimoto expressed optimism about the company’s prospects, noting that although the business is cyclically volatile in the short term, its mid‑to‑long‑term enterprise value growth should outpace GDP growth. Toshiba has now overtaken Bain Capital as the largest shareholder with roughly 15% ownership, while South Korea’s SK Hynix holds about 14% indirectly through a special purpose vehicle, drawing market attention to their competitive and cooperative dynamics. Nomura maintains a “Buy” rating on Armored Knight, arguing that AI‑driven enterprise storage demand remains in a rapid growth phase and that NAND price gains may continue to exceed market expectations.

items.title: 力積電創辦人黃崇仁辭世 走過千億負債重返榮耀、半導體傳奇謝幕
items.title_en: Founder of Powerchip Semiconductor, Huang Chong-Jen, Passes Away: From Billion-Dollar Debt to a Return to Glory, A Semiconductor Legend Ends
paras: 力積電 (6770-TW) 今 (31) 日發布重大聲明，董事長暨創辦人黃崇仁於今日中午因心肺衰竭，在自宅睡夢中安詳離世。公司表示，副董事長謝再居將依法代理董事長職務，產銷業務仍將依照既定規劃有序推進，全體員工也將持續投入營運，延續董事長黃崇仁為台灣高科技產業開拓新局的志業。
黃崇仁縱橫台灣半導體業數十年，當中最為人所知的事蹟就是歷經 DRAM 景氣崩盤、公司下市與逾千億元負債，最終帶領力晶轉型為晶圓代工廠力積電，被業界形容為歷經多次危機仍能東山再起的「九命怪貓」，也是台灣半導體產業最具話題性的企業家之一。
黃崇仁為紐約西奈山醫學院醫學博士學位，1980 年返台後，曾在台北醫學院生理系及台大物理系任教。隨著台灣個人電腦產業起飛，他離開學術界投入創業，先後跨足電腦周邊、軟體及資訊產業，之後將事業版圖延伸至半導體。
為降低台灣電子產業對進口 DRAM 等關鍵零組件的依賴，黃崇仁在當時與日本三菱電機洽談合作，並在 1994 年成立力晶半導體，成為台灣第一家中日合資 DRAM 廠。力晶 1996 年建成首座 8 吋晶圓廠，投入 16Mb DRAM 生產，但量產之際即遭逢全球記憶體價格崩盤，讓公司一成立便面臨嚴峻考驗。
黃崇仁此後持續推動增資、擴產及製程升級，並帶領力晶建置台灣首座 12 吋晶圓廠，透過自建與購併迅速掌握 3 座 12 吋廠，一度躍居台灣 DRAM 產業龍頭。然而，2008 年金融海嘯與全球 DRAM 供過於求，讓記憶體業陷入大洗牌，奇夢達、爾必達及台灣多家 DRAM 廠陸續退出市場，力晶也因龐大虧損及債務壓力，在 2012 年股票下櫃。
當時力晶背負約 1,200 億元債務，黃崇仁並未選擇退出，而是將經營重心由標準型 DRAM 轉向晶圓代工，導入更具彈性的「Open Foundry」策略，同時布局邏輯與記憶體製程，逐步改善產品組合及財務結構。經過多年轉型、償債與組織重整，力晶於 2019 年完成事業切割與重組，由力積電承接晶圓製造業務，並於 2021 年重新掛牌上市，更在當時掀起熱潮。
力積電重新上市時，黃崇仁曾將此視為對數十萬名力晶股東的交代。從負債千億元、股票下櫃，到重返資本市場，這段歷程也成為其企業生涯最具代表性的轉折。
面對 AI 浪潮，黃崇仁仍持續推動力積電轉型，近期更在本月法說會露面，強調力積電已不再是傳統成熟製程晶圓代工廠，而要朝向結合記憶體、邏輯製程及先進封裝的「AI Foundry」發展。
力積電近年投入晶圓堆疊、矽中介層及矽電容等技術，並規劃切入 HBM 後段晶圓製造服務，希望在 AI 晶片與 3D 整合趨勢中建立新的成長支柱。直到本月中旬，黃崇仁仍公開說明公司晶圓堆疊與矽電容布局，展現推動力積電轉型的強烈企圖。
力積電表示，黃崇仁離世後，副董事長謝再居將依法代理董事長職務，公司產銷及營運計畫不受影響，將依照既定方向有序推進。
paras_en: Powerchip Semiconductor (6770-TW) issued a major statement today (31st), announcing that Chairman and founder Huang Chong-Jen peacefully passed away this noon from cardiopulmonary failure while sleeping at home. The company said Vice Chairman Hsieh Tsai-Chu will legally act as chairman, and the production and sales business will continue according to the established plan, with all employees remaining committed to operations, continuing Huang Chong-Jen's mission to open new frontiers for Taiwan's high‑tech industry.

Huang Chong-Jen traversed Taiwan's semiconductor industry for decades, most famously surviving the DRAM market collapse, the company's delisting and over NT$100 billion in debt, ultimately steering Powerchip's transformation into the foundry Powerchip Semiconductor. The industry dubbed him a “nine‑lives cat” who could rise again after multiple crises, making him one of the most talked‑about entrepreneurs in Taiwan's semiconductor sector.

Huang earned a medical doctorate from New York's Sinai Hospital Medical College. After returning to Taiwan in 1980, he taught in the physiology department of Taipei Medical College and the physics department of National Taiwan University. As Taiwan’s personal computer industry took off, he left academia to start businesses, first in computer peripherals, software and information services, and later expanding into semiconductors.

To reduce Taiwan’s reliance on imported DRAM and other key components, Huang negotiated a partnership with Japan’s Mitsubishi Electric and founded Powerchip Semiconductor in 1994, Taiwan’s first Sino‑Japanese joint‑venture DRAM plant. In 1996 Powerchip completed its first 8‑inch wafer fab, producing 16‑Mb DRAM, but global memory price collapse hit just as mass production began, subjecting the newborn company to severe challenges.

Huang continued to push capital increases, capacity expansion and process upgrades, leading Powerchip to build Taiwan’s first 12‑inch wafer fab. Through both organic builds and acquisitions, the company quickly controlled three 12‑inch fabs, becoming the leader of Taiwan’s DRAM industry. However, the 2008 financial crisis and worldwide DRAM oversupply triggered a massive industry shake‑out; rivals such as Qimonda, Elpida and several Taiwanese DRAM makers exited the market, and Powerchip, burdened by huge losses and debt, was delisted in 2012.

At that time Powerchip carried roughly NT$120 billion of debt. Rather than quit, Huang shifted focus from standard‑cell DRAM to wafer‑foundry services, adopting a more flexible “Open Foundry” model and adding logic and memory process lines to gradually improve the product mix and financial structure. After years of transformation, debt repayment and organizational restructuring, Powerchip completed a business split and reorganization in 2019, with Powerchip Semiconductor taking over wafer manufacturing, and re‑listed in 2021, sparking a market rally.

When Powerchip re‑listed, Huang said it was a response to the hundreds of thousands of Powerchip shareholders. The journey from a trillion‑NTD debt and delisting back to the capital markets became the most emblematic turning point of his career.

Facing the AI wave, Huang kept driving Powerchip’s transformation. At this month’s earnings conference he emphasized that Powerchip is no longer a traditional mature‑process foundry but is moving toward an “AI Foundry” that integrates memory, logic and advanced packaging.

In recent years Powerchip has invested in wafer stacking, silicon interposers and silicon capacitors, and plans to enter back‑end HBM wafer services, aiming to build a new growth pillar amid AI chips and 3D integration trends. As late as mid‑month, Huang publicly explained the company’s wafer‑stacking and silicon‑capacitor strategies, showing strong determination to push the transformation forward.

Powerchip stated that after Huang’s passing, Vice Chairman Hsieh Tsai-Chu will legally act as chairman, and the company’s production, sales and operational plans will remain unaffected and will proceed orderly according to the established direction.

items.title: 極端恐慌變極致狂歡！台股狂甩融資大反攻，V轉還是假反彈？「這個關鍵位階」絕不能做錯！
items.title_en: Extreme Panic Turns Into Extreme Euphoria! Taiwan Stocks Dump Margin Funding in a Massive Counterattack, Is the V‑Turn Real or a Fake Bounce? The "Key Resistance Level" Must Not Be Missed!
paras: 當情緒從極致恐慌瞬間轉為狂歡，大盤以驚人氣勢上演大甩尾！但在急速修復背後，空手資金陷入焦慮，究竟這是一波直球 V 轉，還是強勢技術性反彈？指數即將面臨的「關鍵壓力位階」是重要分水嶺，想抓緊輪動節奏，千萬別在轉折點做錯決定。
〈台股史上最大單日漲點，情緒觸底後的強勢修復〉

items.title: 離岸風電面臨多重挑戰 台灣風力發電產業協會理事長許逸德提四大建言
items.title_en: Offshore Wind Faces Multiple Challenges; Taiwan Wind Power Industry Association Chairman Hsu I‑teh Offers Four Key Recommendations
paras: 台灣風力發電發展協會今 (31) 日舉辦會員大會暨尖峰論壇，華城 (1519-TW) 總經理、同時也是協會理事長的許逸德與風電業界同步指出，可預測性、可融資、可執行與供應鏈韌性為推動離岸產業發展的重要基礎。
離岸風電 3-3 期選商在即，許逸德表示，3-3 期不僅是新一輪選商，更攸關國家能源安全、綠電供應及本土供應鏈的永續發展。
而台灣風力發電產業發展協會同步舉辦「離岸風電 R3-3 期區塊開發選商機制下專案控管與風險管理論壇」，並邀集開發商、風機商、統包商與設備商對話。面對全球高利率、供應連重組與 2030 年前後大量風場集中併網等挑戰，風電業界提出四大政策建言，呼籲政府打造穩定、透明且可預測的市場機制，作為推動台灣離岸風電下一階段發展的基礎。
首先業界呼籲，必須有穩定且連續性的案場釋出，是支撐投資信心與供應鏈持續投入的關鍵，也提升市場可預測性；第二，面臨全球高利率與資本市場變化，須有完整的融資制度，建議優化融資保證與金融支持機制，降低開發風險，吸引更多國內外資金投入台灣離岸風電市場。
第三，業界表示，未來大量風場集中施工與併網，將對工程人力、施工船舶、港口、設備及電網資源帶來壓力，建議優化併網與行政協調，提升專案執行效率；最後，業界認為，台灣離岸風電已建立完整的在地供應鏈，因此須強化供應鏈韌性，提升國際競爭力。
許逸德也再度重申，離岸風電產業真正的挑戰並非裝置容量大小，而是可預測性、可融資、可執行與供應鏈韌性四大關鍵。
台灣風力發電產業協會今天也同步改選理監事，新任理事長將由東元 (1504-TW) 副董事長吳素秋接任。
paras_en: The Taiwan Wind Power Development Association held its member meeting and peak forum today (31st). Hsu I‑teh, General Manager of Hua Cheng (1519‑TW) and also the association’s chairman, together with the wind power industry highlighted that predictability, financing, execution, and supply‑chain resilience are essential foundations for advancing the offshore sector.

Hsu noted that the upcoming Phase 3‑3 offshore wind tender is not only a new round of vendor selection but also crucial for national energy security, green‑power supply, and the sustainable development of the domestic supply chain.

The association concurrently organized a “Offshore Wind R3‑3 Phase Block Development Tender Mechanism Project Control and Risk Management Forum,” inviting developers, turbine manufacturers, EPC contractors and equipment suppliers to dialogue. Confronted with global high interest rates, supply‑chain restructuring and the massive concentration and grid‑integration of wind farms around 2030, the industry put forward four policy recommendations, urging the government to create a stable, transparent and predictable market mechanism as the basis for the next stage of Taiwan’s offshore wind development.

First, the industry calls for a stable and continuous release of project sites, which underpins investor confidence, sustains supply‑chain participation and enhances market predictability.; Second, amid global high rates and shifting capital markets, a comprehensive financing framework is needed; the industry suggests optimizing financing guarantees and financial support mechanisms to lower development risk and attract more domestic and foreign capital into Taiwan’s offshore wind market.; Third, the industry warns that the upcoming large‑scale, concentrated construction and grid‑integration of wind farms will strain engineering labor, installation vessels, ports, equipment and grid resources, and recommends streamlining grid‑connection and administrative coordination to improve project execution efficiency.; Fourth, the industry asserts that Taiwan’s offshore wind sector has built a complete local supply chain, but it must strengthen supply‑chain resilience to boost international competitiveness.

Hsu reiterated that the real challenges for the offshore wind industry are not the size of installed capacity but the four key pillars of predictability, financing, execution and supply‑chain resilience.
The Taiwan Wind Power Development Association also held elections for its board and supervisory directors today; the new chairman will be Wu Su‑chiu, Vice Chairman of TECO (1504‑TW).

items.title: 進泰電子營收轉爲正成長 宣布完成現增籌資2.1億元
items.title_en: Jin Tai Electronics Reports Positive Revenue Growth and Announces Completion of a 210 Million TWD Capital Increase
paras: 音訊產品供應商進泰電子 (3465-TW) 以發行 7000 張現增股自市場籌資，此一現增案以每股 30 元溢價發行，今 (31) 日宣布完成完成募集並自市場籌資 2.1 億元，進泰電子現增預計 8 月 5 日上櫃交易。
同時，進泰電子度過第一季的新事業及開發新機種陣痛期，2026 年第二季業績表現向上，繼 4 月營收 1.94 億元後，5 月營收持續上攀進入近年高檔期，達 2.32 億元，年增 1.91 倍，第二季營收 6.17 億元，年增 57.49%，並可望轉盈。
進泰電子 2026 年 1-6 月營收 9.54 億元，較 2025 年同期成長轉正，年增 14.35%，將在 8 月 4 日公布最新財報。
進泰電子 2026 年第一季營收 3.37 億元，年減 23.84%、歸屬母公司達 3243 萬元的虧損，每股淨損達 0.92 元，主要因客戶旗艦新機工藝技術門檻高、AI 強潮影響電子關鍵零組件的穩定供應，以及首季中有春節長假等，影響整體產量，加上投入影音擴大機業務初期支出較高所造成。
進泰電子在越南產能成長，目前透過積極取得關鍵材料穩定料源，新機產製學習曲線已見成效，4 月起營收已回復成長軌道，目前工廠全線趕工並加開組裝線產能，去化客戶訂單，最差情況已過，隨著客戶訂單在旗艦機種出貨量增，也對第三季業績不看淡。
法人估，進泰電子 2026 年營運可望逐季攀高，進泰隨著影音擴大機產品出貨，將力拚 2027 年營運締造高峰。
paras_en: Audio product supplier Jin Tai Electronics (3465-TW) raised capital from the market by issuing 7,000 new shares at a premium of NT$30 per share, completing a fundraising of NT$210 million on the 31st. The capital increase is slated to begin trading on the OTC market on August 5.

At the same time, Jin Tai Electronics has moved past the first‑quarter pain of launching new businesses and developing new models. In the second quarter of 2026, performance improved: after April revenue of NT$194 million, May revenue climbed to NT$232 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 1.91 times. Second‑quarter revenue reached NT$617 million, up 57.49% year‑over‑year, and the company is expected to turn to profit.

Jin Tai Electronics' revenue for the first half of 2026 was NT$954 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 14.35% compared with the same period in 2025, and the latest financial results will be announced on August 4.

In the first quarter of 2026, revenue was NT$337 million, down 23.84% year‑over‑year, with a loss attributable to the parent company of NT$32.43 million, or a net loss per share of NT$0.92. The decline was mainly due to the high technical barriers of a flagship new device from a key customer, AI‑driven demand pressures on critical electronic components, a long Lunar New Year holiday that reduced overall output, and higher early‑stage expenses from expanding the audio‑visual equipment business.

Jin Tai Electronics' production capacity in Vietnam is growing. By actively securing key material supplies, the learning curve for the new product line has begun to show results, and revenue has been back on a growth trajectory since April. The factory has accelerated work across all lines and added assembly‑line capacity to fulfill customer orders; the worst‑case scenario has passed. As flagship device shipments increase, the outlook for the third quarter remains positive.

Analysts estimate that Jin Tai Electronics' operations in 2026 will continue to improve quarter by quarter, and with the expansion of its audio‑visual equipment shipments, the company aims to reach a performance peak in 2027.

paras: 工業電腦大廠研華 (2395-TW) 今 (31) 日公告第二季財報，稅後純益 45.18 億元，季增 35.50%、年增 127.15%、每股純益 5.2 元，創歷史新高；上半年稅後純益 78.52 億元，年增 66.25%、每股純益 9.05 元，也是歷史同期新高。
研華第二季營收 261.26 億元，季增 28.16%、年增 46.48%、毛利率 37.68%，季減 1.46 個百分點、年減 2.31 個百分點、營業利益 51.27 億元，季增 37.52%、年增 64.17%、營業利益率 19.63%，季增 1.33 個百分點、年增 2.11 個百分點。

整體營運以區域別而言，北美、歐洲及新興市場均年增約 3 成，中國年增 51%、北亞年增 24%、台灣年增 67%；各事業群整體表現突出，智能系統年增 34%、物聯網自動化年增 19%、嵌入式事業群年增 28%、智能服務也有個位數年增。
paras_en: Industrial computer giant Advantech (2395‑TW) announced its second‑quarter results today (31st), reporting a post‑tax net profit of NT$4.518 billion, up 35.50% quarter‑over‑quarter and 127.15% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$5.20, a historic high. For the first half of the year, net profit reached NT$7.852 billion, up 66.25% YoY, and EPS was NT$9.05, also a record high for the same period.

Advantech’s Q2 revenue was NT$26.126 billion, up 28.16% QoQ and 46.48% YoY. Gross margin stood at 37.68%, down 1.46 percentage points QoQ and 2.31 points YoY. Operating profit was NT$5.127 billion, up 37.52% QoQ and 64.17% YoY, with an operating margin of 19.63%, an increase of 1.33 percentage points QoQ and 2.11 points YoY.

The company said the first half benefited from global customers accelerating AI deployments, which kept demand for related applications strong. Although Q2 gross margin slipped due to short‑term volatility in key raw‑material prices, the larger revenue base allowed both the quarter and the first half to deliver robust profit growth and set new historical highs.

For the first half of the year, Advantech recorded revenue of NT$46.512 billion, up 32.18% YoY, with a gross margin of 38.32% (down 1.92 percentage points YoY). Operating profit was NT$8.856 billion, up 46.44% YoY, and operating margin rose to 19.04%, an increase of 1.85 percentage points YoY.

By region, overall operations saw roughly 30% YoY growth in North America, Europe and emerging markets; China grew 51%, North Asia 24%, and Taiwan 67%. All business groups performed strongly: the Smart Systems segment grew 34%, IoT Automation 19%, Embedded Business 28%, and Smart Services posted single‑digit growth.

paras_en: The Shanghai Shipping Exchange released the latest Shanghai Container Freight Index (SCFI) today (31st), ending a three‑day slide at 3,205.97 points, up 143.02 points or 4.67%. Rates on the four major long‑haul routes moved in opposite directions: the Europe route fell while the U.S. route rebounded sharply, with the Far East‑to‑U.S. East Coast rate jumping $1,014 per FEU, breaking the $9,000 barrier.
Among the main routes this week, Far East‑to‑Europe fell $116 per TEU to $3,039, a decline of 3.68%; Far East‑to‑Mediterranean fell $162 per TEU to $4,189, down 3.72%.

However, Far East‑to‑U.S. West Coast rates surged $694 per FEU (standard 40‑foot container) to $6,229, a rise of 12.54%, and Far East‑to‑U.S. East Coast rates jumped $1,014 per FEU to $9,054, up 12.61%.

paras: 總統賴清德今 (31) 日出席「2026 年台灣美食展開幕典禮」時表示，美食展不僅能讓大家品嘗各地美食、認識台灣風俗民情，更是推動觀光發展及國際交流的重要平台，未來政府將持續串連美食、觀光步道及會展等多項元素，朝 2030 年起每年均 1 千萬人次國際旅客來台、觀光產值突破兆元的目標邁進，也歡迎國人把握機會前來觀展。
賴清德致詞表示，「台灣美食展」有幾項重要的意義：第一，民以食為天，不論是排灣族以動人悅耳的歌曲邀請大家一起吃飯，或是台灣人的日常問候「呷飽未」，若想了解各地的美食，最簡單的方式就是來到「台灣美食展」，不僅可以吃遍各地美食，也能認識台灣各地風俗民情。
第二，「台灣美食展」也是推動台灣觀光的重要策略之一，台灣以觀光立國，有美麗的地景、豐厚的文化及台灣最美的風景就是人，其中美食也是推動觀光產業的重要元素。去 (2025) 年外國來台灣光旅客近 860 萬人次，今年可望較去年增加，期盼在 2030 年達到每年 1 千萬人次國際旅客來台及觀光產值破兆元的目標。
至於美食展的第三個重要意義，賴清德認為，美食是交朋友非常好的方式，近期巴拉圭貝尼亞總統訪台，除了參訪台積電 (2330-TW) 外，也前往台南阿霞飯店品嚐在地台菜美食，不但吃得津津有味，也留下非常難忘的回憶。在國際重要領袖來台時，以台灣在地美食，庶民美食款待外賓也非常重要。
除了推動美食展外，賴清德也說，近期政府推出「縱走台灣 Twalk」，規劃 6 條觀光步道，吸引外國旅客來臺灣旅遊，希望未來能透過美食、縱走山林綠道等多元的旅遊體驗相互串連，達到吸引國際旅客來台的目標。
賴清德表示，未來政府積極推動美食會展與觀光產業結合，以最為人熟知的台北國際電腦展 (COMPUTEX) 為例，每年都有許多國際專業人士來到台灣，希望能將來台參展的專業人士轉化為觀光旅客，到各地品嘗美食、健走及體驗在地風土民情，這也是未來政府要持續努力的方向。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te said at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Taiwan Food Expo today (31) that the expo not only lets people taste foods from around the island and learn about Taiwanese customs, but also serves as an important platform for tourism development and international exchange. The government will continue to link food, hiking trails and conventions, aiming for 10 million international visitors each year from 2030 and tourism output exceeding a trillion dollars, and he invited citizens to take the opportunity to attend the expo.

In his speech Lai noted several key meanings of the Taiwan Food Expo. First, food is fundamental to people’s lives; whether it’s the Paiwan tribe inviting everyone to share a meal with moving songs or the everyday Taiwanese greeting “Have you eaten?”, the simplest way to learn about regional cuisines is to come to the Taiwan Food Expo, where you can sample dishes from across the island and get to know local customs.

Second, the expo is a major strategy for promoting Taiwan’s tourism. Taiwan builds its economy on tourism, boasting beautiful scenery, rich culture and, most importantly, its people, with food being a vital tourism element. In 2025, foreign visitors to Taiwan numbered nearly 8.6 million, and this year is expected to exceed last year’s figure, with the aim of reaching 10 million international visitors annually and tourism output surpassing a trillion dollars by 2030.

A third significance, Lai said, is that food is an excellent way to make friends. During the recent visit of Paraguay’s President Santiago Peña, he not only toured TSMC (2330‑TW) but also dined on local Taiwanese cuisine at the Ah‑Hsi Hotel in Tainan, enjoying the meal and creating lasting memories. Serving local, popular dishes to visiting world leaders is therefore very important.

Beyond the food expo, Lai mentioned the government’s newly launched “Twalk” initiative, which plans six tourism trails to attract foreign travelers to Taiwan. He hopes that by linking food experiences with mountain‑greenway hikes and other diverse tourism activities, the goal of drawing more international visitors can be achieved.

Lai said the government will actively integrate food exhibitions with the tourism industry. Using the well‑known Taipei Computer Exhibition (COMPUTEX) as an example, each year many international professionals come to Taiwan. The aim is to convert these participants into tourists who travel around the island to taste food, hike, and experience local culture, a direction the government will continue to pursue.

items.title: 力積電創辦人黃崇仁辭世 走過千億負債重返榮耀、半導體傳奇謝幕
items.title_en: Founder of Powerchip Semiconductor, Huang Chong-Jen, Passes Away: From Billion-Dollar Debt to a Return to Glory, A Semiconductor Legend Ends
paras: 力積電 (6770-TW) 今 (31) 日發布重大聲明，董事長暨創辦人黃崇仁於今日中午因心肺衰竭，在自宅睡夢中安詳離世。公司表示，副董事長謝再居將依法代理董事長職務，產銷業務仍將依照既定規劃有序推進，全體員工也將持續投入營運，延續董事長黃崇仁為台灣高科技產業開拓新局的志業。
黃崇仁縱橫台灣半導體業數十年，當中最為人所知的事蹟就是歷經 DRAM 景氣崩盤、公司下市與逾千億元負債，最終帶領力晶轉型為晶圓代工廠力積電，被業界形容為歷經多次危機仍能東山再起的「九命怪貓」，也是台灣半導體產業最具話題性的企業家之一。
黃崇仁為紐約西奈山醫學院醫學博士學位，1980 年返台後，曾在台北醫學院生理系及台大物理系任教。隨著台灣個人電腦產業起飛，他離開學術界投入創業，先後跨足電腦周邊、軟體及資訊產業，之後將事業版圖延伸至半導體。
為降低台灣電子產業對進口 DRAM 等關鍵零組件的依賴，黃崇仁在當時與日本三菱電機洽談合作，並在 1994 年成立力晶半導體，成為台灣第一家中日合資 DRAM 廠。力晶 1996 年建成首座 8 吋晶圓廠，投入 16Mb DRAM 生產，但量產之際即遭逢全球記憶體價格崩盤，讓公司一成立便面臨嚴峻考驗。
黃崇仁此後持續推動增資、擴產及製程升級，並帶領力晶建置台灣首座 12 吋晶圓廠，透過自建與購併迅速掌握 3 座 12 吋廠，一度躍居台灣 DRAM 產業龍頭。然而，2008 年金融海嘯與全球 DRAM 供過於求，讓記憶體業陷入大洗牌，奇夢達、爾必達及台灣多家 DRAM 廠陸續退出市場，力晶也因龐大虧損及債務壓力，在 2012 年股票下櫃。
當時力晶背負約 1,200 億元債務，黃崇仁並未選擇退出，而是將經營重心由標準型 DRAM 轉向晶圓代工，導入更具彈性的「Open Foundry」策略，同時布局邏輯與記憶體製程，逐步改善產品組合及財務結構。經過多年轉型、償債與組織重整，力晶於 2019 年完成事業切割與重組，由力積電承接晶圓製造業務，並於 2021 年重新掛牌上市，更在當時掀起熱潮。
力積電重新上市時，黃崇仁曾將此視為對數十萬名力晶股東的交代。從負債千億元、股票下櫃，到重返資本市場，這段歷程也成為其企業生涯最具代表性的轉折。
面對 AI 浪潮，黃崇仁仍持續推動力積電轉型，近期更在本月法說會露面，強調力積電已不再是傳統成熟製程晶圓代工廠，而要朝向結合記憶體、邏輯製程及先進封裝的「AI Foundry」發展。
力積電近年投入晶圓堆疊、矽中介層及矽電容等技術，並規劃切入 HBM 後段晶圓製造服務，希望在 AI 晶片與 3D 整合趨勢中建立新的成長支柱。直到本月中旬，黃崇仁仍公開說明公司晶圓堆疊與矽電容布局，展現推動力積電轉型的強烈企圖。
力積電表示，黃崇仁離世後，副董事長謝再居將依法代理董事長職務，公司產銷及營運計畫不受影響，將依照既定方向有序推進。
paras_en: Powerchip Semiconductor (6770-TW) issued a major statement today (31st), announcing that Chairman and founder Huang Chong-Jen peacefully passed away this noon from cardiopulmonary failure while sleeping at home. The company said Vice Chairman Hsieh Tsai-Chu will legally act as chairman, and the production and sales business will continue according to the established plan, with all employees remaining committed to operations, continuing Huang Chong-Jen's mission to open new frontiers for Taiwan's high‑tech industry.

Huang Chong-Jen traversed Taiwan's semiconductor industry for decades, most famously surviving the DRAM market collapse, the company's delisting and over NT$100 billion in debt, ultimately steering Powerchip's transformation into the foundry Powerchip Semiconductor. The industry dubbed him a “nine‑lives cat” who could rise again after multiple crises, making him one of the most talked‑about entrepreneurs in Taiwan's semiconductor sector.

Huang earned a medical doctorate from New York's Sinai Hospital Medical College. After returning to Taiwan in 1980, he taught in the physiology department of Taipei Medical College and the physics department of National Taiwan University. As Taiwan’s personal computer industry took off, he left academia to start businesses, first in computer peripherals, software and information services, and later expanding into semiconductors.

To reduce Taiwan’s reliance on imported DRAM and other key components, Huang negotiated a partnership with Japan’s Mitsubishi Electric and founded Powerchip Semiconductor in 1994, Taiwan’s first Sino‑Japanese joint‑venture DRAM plant. In 1996 Powerchip completed its first 8‑inch wafer fab, producing 16‑Mb DRAM, but global memory price collapse hit just as mass production began, subjecting the newborn company to severe challenges.

Huang continued to push capital increases, capacity expansion and process upgrades, leading Powerchip to build Taiwan’s first 12‑inch wafer fab. Through both organic builds and acquisitions, the company quickly controlled three 12‑inch fabs, becoming the leader of Taiwan’s DRAM industry. However, the 2008 financial crisis and worldwide DRAM oversupply triggered a massive industry shake‑out; rivals such as Qimonda, Elpida and several Taiwanese DRAM makers exited the market, and Powerchip, burdened by huge losses and debt, was delisted in 2012.

At that time Powerchip carried roughly NT$120 billion of debt. Rather than quit, Huang shifted focus from standard‑cell DRAM to wafer‑foundry services, adopting a more flexible “Open Foundry” model and adding logic and memory process lines to gradually improve the product mix and financial structure. After years of transformation, debt repayment and organizational restructuring, Powerchip completed a business split and reorganization in 2019, with Powerchip Semiconductor taking over wafer manufacturing, and re‑listed in 2021, sparking a market rally.

When Powerchip re‑listed, Huang said it was a response to the hundreds of thousands of Powerchip shareholders. The journey from a trillion‑NTD debt and delisting back to the capital markets became the most emblematic turning point of his career.

Facing the AI wave, Huang kept driving Powerchip’s transformation. At this month’s earnings conference he emphasized that Powerchip is no longer a traditional mature‑process foundry but is moving toward an “AI Foundry” that integrates memory, logic and advanced packaging.

In recent years Powerchip has invested in wafer stacking, silicon interposers and silicon capacitors, and plans to enter back‑end HBM wafer services, aiming to build a new growth pillar amid AI chips and 3D integration trends. As late as mid‑month, Huang publicly explained the company’s wafer‑stacking and silicon‑capacitor strategies, showing strong determination to push the transformation forward.

Powerchip stated that after Huang’s passing, Vice Chairman Hsieh Tsai-Chu will legally act as chairman, and the company’s production, sales and operational plans will remain unaffected and will proceed orderly according to the established direction.

【美律法說會 AI 摘要】2026/7/31

一、 2026 年第二季財務與營運詳情

財務表現：

• 營收與獲利： 第二季合併營收達 104.38 億元，季減但年增 1.07%。營業毛利 10.42 億元，年減 13.81%；毛利率為 9.98%，年減 1.73 個百分點。營業利益為 400 萬元（營業淨利率 0.03%），主要受到毛利率下檔壓力及營業費用上升（包含員工酬勞與併入日本集團費用）所影響。
• 業外與淨利： 本季業外收益達 1.6 億元（年增 280.2%），主因受惠於美金、泰銖與人民幣匯率波動所帶來的本期兌換利益增加。歸屬於母公司淨利為 1.24 億元，單季每股盈餘（EPS）為 0.50 元。
• 營運週期與資金流： 存貨週轉天數增至 78 天（較上季增加 10 天），主因大客戶出貨時間延後，以及中國以外生產比重提升導致海運物流天數拉長。現金及約當現金降至 73.3 億元，自由現金流出 15.04 億元（包含資本支出 2.2 億元，主要用於泰國與越南廠設備投入）。

市場展望與營運挑戰：

• 三大營運挑戰：
上游原料與零件調漲： 石油價格維持高檔帶動石化衍生原料（如塑膠件）上漲；此外，晶片 / 電子元件產能受 AI 需求擠壓，被動元件等缺料致成本攀升。
匯率升值逆風： 主要生產基地於中國（占 50%）、越南與泰國（合計 50%），人民幣升值對「付人民幣、收美金」的成本結構造成壓力。
產能移轉過渡期： 產能自中國移往海外，致使中國廠稼動率下滑、工費率上升；新廠（泰 / 越）設立初期人員生產效率與稼動率尚待優化。 • 下半年及第四季能見度： 第三季進入傳統旺季，營收預計較第二季大幅成長。第四季因中落地緣政治衝突、油價與美國升息疑慮，客戶態度相對保守，能見度仍以第三季為主。

產品線與技術策略：

• 耳機 (Headset) 業務： 第二季營收占比 69%（Audio 占 60%、Gaming 占 27%、TWS 占 13%）。Audio 受惠頭戴耳機與日本併購案綜效顯現；Gaming 隨新機型量產穩健成長；TWS 受市場放緩與新舊機種交替影響下滑。整體耳機市場需求穩定但競爭持續。
• 揚聲器 (Speaker) 業務： 第二季營收占比 23%（Phone 占 40%、Computer 占 23%、Others 占 37%）。Phone 受惠客戶需求成長；Computer 受記憶體缺貨及漲價排擠拉貨；Others 受惠歐系新客戶藍牙喇叭與大功率音箱進入量產，後續毛利率可升。
• 新應用與 On-Device AI 布局： On-device AI 目前積極與客戶進行 POC（概念驗證）及 Roadmap 開發，尚未對營收產生實質貢獻；電池產品受惠新專案量產，預計下半年維持強勁成長。
【美律法說會問答完整清單 (Q&A)】
Q1：今年全年的整體獲利表現相較於去年是否能呈現正成長？目前的能見度為何？ (法人 / 投資人)
回答： 今年的獲利相較去年極具挑戰，主因包含石化原料與被動元件成本調漲、人民幣升值，以及產能移轉海外導致中國廠稼動率下降與海外新廠效率仍待拉升。不過，全年營收目前看來仍會比去年小幅成長。能見度方面，第三季旺季展望明確，第四季因中東衝突、高油價與升息疑慮，客戶拉貨態度相對觀望保守。
Q2：關於 On-Device AI 的佈局，客戶端 POC 的轉化進度為何？何時能對營收產生貢獻？ (法人 / 投資人)
回答： 目前皆仍在與客戶互動與 POC 進行階段。雖然 AI 必然會從基礎建設延伸至終端穿戴裝置，但終端 AI 功能是否能轉化為消費者的剛需與長期需求，市場仍在大腦風暴中。公司已佈局技術 Roadmap，但目前對營收尚無實質貢獻。
Q3：明年高毛利的訂單或新應用產品的成長動能，是否有機會比今年進一步放大？ (法人 / 投資人)
回答： 提升毛利的兩大關鍵為「既有產品改善」與「新產品線注入」。既有產品若能有效控制人民幣匯率、原物料成本並提升海外新廠稼動率，毛利即有改善空間；新產品方面，如今年新增的歐洲攜帶式音箱（Portable Speaker）客戶，第一個專案初期毛利較低，但明年第二個量產專案的毛利將顯著提升，隨規模經濟發揮，產品線毛利率會逐年放大。
Q4：MWT 的營收歸類為何？其稅前淨利率波幅大（1Q 39%、2Q 16%），該如何評估其全年狀況與營收貢獻？ (法人 / 投資人)
回答： MWT 營收歸類在耳機。因其客戶與機種別較少，單一機種 EOL 或 Forecast 變動就會對淨利率產生劇烈影響；預估 MWT 全年稅前淨利率約落於 5% 左右，今年營收貢獻預估低於 20 億元。
Q5：第二季蘇州美特認列的獲利相較於第一季減少 90% 的原因為何？明年展望如何？ (法人 / 投資人)
回答： 主要原因有四：1. 人民幣升值影響毛利；2. 原油上漲拉高塑膠件成本；3. 記憶體缺貨致非美系客戶手機 / PC 出貨量下降，競業轉向搶攻美系客戶訂單，加劇價格競爭；4. 美特今年承接大量新案，量產前認列龐大開發費用。美特明年案子涵蓋美系客戶的平板、手機、PC/NB 及頭戴耳機，隨著新案陸續量產，明年營收預計將有顯著成長。
Q6：第三季美律越南廠的營收與獲利估計為何？ (法人 / 投資人)
回答： 越南廠約佔公司整體營收的 25% 左右；其經營效率與獲利表現相對穩定，稅後淨利率可維持在 8.5% 至 8.7% 之間。
Q7：第三季 Speaker 營收比重較第二季提升，是否會導致整體毛利率低於第二季？ (法人 / 投資人)
回答： 單看產品組合影響確實如此，但仍須視最大營收來源耳機的毛利走勢。第二季頭戴耳機處於量產初期毛利偏低，經過兩三個月拉升後，第三季耳機毛利率正逐漸上升。整體毛利率走勢將取決於兩大產品線增減速度的互相抵銷結果。

I. Detailed Financial and Operational Highlights for Q2 2026
Financial performance:

• Revenue and profit: Q2 consolidated revenue reached NT$10.438 billion, down quarter‑on‑quarter but up 1.07% year‑on‑year. Operating gross profit was NT$1.042 billion, down 13.81% YoY; gross margin stood at 9.98%, a decline of 1.73 percentage points YoY. Operating profit was NT$4 million (operating margin 0.03%), mainly due to pressure on gross margin and higher operating expenses (including employee compensation and costs absorbed from the Japanese group).

• Non‑operating and net profit: Non‑operating income this quarter was NT$160 million, up 280.2% YoY, driven by favorable exchange‑rate gains on USD, THB and CNY. Net profit attributable to the parent was NT$124 million, yielding an EPS of NT$0.50 for the quarter.

• Operating cycle and cash flow: Inventory turnover days rose to 78 days (10 days longer than the prior quarter) because of delayed shipments to a major customer and a higher share of production outside China, which lengthened ocean‑freight times. Cash and cash equivalents fell to NT$7.33 billion, and free cash flow was a negative NT$1.504 billion (including capital expenditures of NT$220 million, mainly for equipment at factories in Thailand and Vietnam).
Market outlook and operational challenges:
• Three major operational challenges:

1. Up‑stream raw‑material and component price hikes: High oil prices are pushing up petrochemical derivatives such as plastic parts; in addition, chip and electronic component capacity is being squeezed by AI demand, causing shortages of passive components and higher costs.

2. Currency appreciation headwinds: The main production bases are in China (50%), Vietnam and Thailand (combined 50%). RMB appreciation puts pressure on a cost structure that involves paying in RMB while receiving USD.

3. Capacity‑transfer transition period: Shifting capacity from China to overseas lowers the utilization rate of Chinese plants and raises labor cost ratios; new plants in Thailand and Vietnam are still improving personnel productivity and utilization rates.

• Visibility for the second half and Q4: Q3 enters the traditional peak season, with revenue expected to grow sharply versus Q2. Q4 visibility remains tied to Q3 because of Middle‑East geopolitical tensions, oil‑price concerns and U.S. rate‑hike worries, leading customers to adopt a more cautious ordering stance.
Product line and technology strategy:

• Headset business: Headset revenue accounted for 69% of Q2 sales (Audio 60%, Gaming 27%, TWS 13%). Audio benefited from over‑ear headphones and synergies from the recent Japan acquisition; Gaming grew steadily as new models entered mass production; TWS declined due to a market slowdown and the transition between old and new models. Overall headset demand is stable but competition stays intense.

• Speaker business: Speaker revenue made up 23% of Q2 sales (Phone 40%, Computer 23%, Others 37%). Phone segment was helped by growing customer demand; Computer segment faced pressure from memory shortages and price hikes; Others benefited from new European Bluetooth speaker customers and high‑power speaker volume production, with margin improvement expected thereafter.

• New applications and on‑device AI roadmap: On‑device AI is currently in active proof‑of‑concept (POC) and roadmap development with customers, but it has not yet contributed materially to revenue. Battery products are benefiting from new project volume production and are expected to maintain strong growth in the second half.
Full Q&A list from the American Legal earnings call:
Q1: Will the full‑year profit this year show positive growth compared with last year? What is the current visibility? (Institutional / Investor)

Answer: Profit this year is highly challenging versus last year, mainly because of higher petrochemical raw‑material and passive‑component costs, RMB appreciation, and the overseas capacity shift that lowered utilization at Chinese plants while new overseas plants are still ramping up. Nevertheless, total revenue for the year is still expected to grow modestly over last year. Visibility is clear for the Q3 peak season; Q4 is more uncertain due to Middle‑East conflict, high oil prices and rate‑hike concerns, prompting customers to adopt a more cautious ordering posture.
Q2: Regarding the on‑device AI rollout, what is the conversion progress of customer POCs? When can it start contributing to revenue? (Institutional / Investor)

Answer: All projects are still in the interaction and POC stage with customers. Although AI will inevitably extend from infrastructure to end‑user wearables, whether end‑device AI functions become a genuine consumer need and long‑term demand is still being debated. The company has a technical roadmap in place, but there is no material revenue impact yet.
Q3: Will high‑margin orders or new‑application product growth next year have the chance to expand beyond this year’s momentum? (Institutional / Investor)

Answer: The two main levers for margin improvement are "existing‑product enhancements" and "new‑product line introductions." If existing products can better control RMB exchange rates, raw‑material costs and improve utilization at overseas plants, margins can improve. For new products, the European portable speaker customer added this year had low initial margins, but the second mass‑production project planned for next year will see a significant margin lift, and economies of scale will further raise the product‑line margin over time.
Q4: How is MWT revenue classified? Its pre‑tax net‑margin swung widely (39% in 1Q, 16% in 2Q). How should we assess its full‑year outlook and revenue contribution? (Institutional / Investor)

Answer: MWT revenue is classified under headsets. Because it serves a limited number of customers and models, a single model’s end‑of‑life or forecast change can cause large swings in net margin. We estimate MWT’s full‑year pre‑tax margin to settle around 5%, with revenue contribution expected to be under NT$2 billion for the year.
Q5: Why did Suzhou Mett’s profit in Q2 drop 90% versus Q1, and what is the outlook for next year? (Institutional / Investor)

Answer: Four main reasons: 1) RMB appreciation hurting margins; 2) Rising crude oil increasing plastic‑part costs; 3) Memory shortages reducing shipments of non‑U.S.‑brand phones/PCs, while competitors shifted to chase U.S.‑brand orders, intensifying price competition; 4) Mett booked large development expenses this year before mass production of many new projects. Next year, Mett’s pipeline includes U.S.‑brand tablets, phones, PC/notebooks and over‑ear headphones; as these new projects move into volume production, revenue is expected to grow markedly.
Q6: What are the estimated revenue and profit for the Vietnam plant in Q3? (Institutional / Investor)

Answer: The Vietnam plant accounts for roughly 25% of total company revenue; its operating efficiency and profitability are relatively stable, with an after‑tax margin expected to stay between 8.5% and 8.7%.
Q7: Speaker revenue’s share is higher in Q3 than Q2; will this cause overall gross margin to fall below Q2 levels? (Institutional / Investor)

Answer: Looking solely at product mix, that effect is true, but the overall outcome also depends on the margin trend of the largest revenue source—headsets. In Q2, over‑ear headphones were in early mass production with low margins; after two‑three months the margins rose. In Q3, headset gross margin is trending upward. The overall gross‑margin trajectory will be determined by the offsetting impact of the two main product lines.

【光寶科法說會 AI 摘要】2026/7/31

一、 2026 年第二季財務與營運詳情

財務表現：

• 營收與獲利： 第二季合併營收達 NT527 億元，季增 213.14 元，年增 126%，刷新歷年最佳紀錄。
• 上半年累積： 上半年合併營收 NT961 億元，年增 254.80 元，年增 66%，各項獲利指標均締造歷史新猷。
• 股利政策： 董事會決議通過配發 2026 年第二季每股現金股利 NT$2.5 元。

市場展望與 AI 需求：

• 轉型成果： 公司已從傳統 OEM/ODM 模式轉型為能提供高價值解決方案的系統整合商（Solution Provider）。受惠於新一代 AI 資料中心需求強勁，加上部分高階機種出貨自第一季遞延至第二季，帶動高價值事業比重與獲利提升。
• 雲端事業強勁： 雲端運算相關業務第二季年成長超過七成；雲端與物聯網部門上半年營收佔比已升至 54%，預計全年 AI 相關產品營收佔比將迅速突破三成。
• 營運展望： 展望第三季，預期核心事業將維持強勁的年增與季增走勢；預估上下半年營收比重約為 42~45% 比 55~58%。

資本配置與海外擴產：

• 資本支出上修： 為了因應 AI 與高階電源快速成長的需求，2026 年全年資本支出（CapEx）由上一季預估的 130 億元上修至 180 億元。資金主要用於購置高功率 / AI 專用研發與測試設備（約占 70%）以及廠房設施機電建置（約占 30%）。
• 全球產能布局： 臺灣高雄二期與越南廣寧廠預計分別於今年第三季與第四季正式投入量產。美國德州麥金尼市（McKinney）9.19 億美元投資案於 8 月中動土整建，預計 2026 年底取得使用執照、2027 年第一季試產、第二季正式量產。預計 2026 年底非中國（Non-China）產能佔比將超過 60%，2027 年進一步提升至 70%。

產品技術與策略投資：

• AI 電源與機櫃方案： 新一代 110kW Power Shelf、BBU（高效備援電池系統）及 800V HVDC Power Rack 等高階產品將於下半年進入驗證與量產階段；800V HVDC Power Rack 預計 8 月送樣，11 月啟動小量出貨，主要放量預計落在 2027 年第一季。
• 策略投資新加坡 DenseLight： 董事會通過以 3,430 萬美元取得新加坡 InP（磷化銦）光通訊元件廠 DenseLight 21% 股權與一席董事。將結合其 CWDM Laser、Gain Chip 等核心技術，布局未來 1.6T/3.2T 光引擎、光模組及 CPO（共封裝光學）市場。
• 收購南京 DCDC 研發團隊： 佈局高階 DC-DC 轉換器技術，以因應未來 HVDC 轉高功率直供架構之需求。

【光寶科法說會問答完整清單 (Q&A)】

Q1：第二季毛利率大幅回升的原因？第一季的存貨呆滯損失是否有迴轉？
回答： 第二季客戶拉貨時確實有些許迴轉，但影響並不重大。毛利率顯著提升（達 27.2%）主因是第一季部分出貨遞延至第二季、雲端高價值產品佔比顯著提升（成長近七成），以及全球產能規模經濟發揮。建議由上半年整體角度來看（毛利率約 24.7%），未來經營目標是將毛利率穩定維持在 25% 以上並長期向上走高。
Q2：資本支出從 130 億上修至 180 億元的具體細節？是否包含美國德州廠？
回答： 180 億元已包含美國建廠與擴廠所需費用。其中約 30% 用於土地與廠房建置 / 擴建，70% 用於高規格研發測試設備、自動化與生產線設備。由於 AI 高功率產品（如 Power Rack）測試規範完全不同，設備需重新量身訂製與重構。
Q3：關鍵零組件緊缺與漲價（如 PC 板、半導體）的應對策略？
回答： 公司採取提前 6 個月運作的策略性採購與備料。增加的存貨均已與 CSP 客戶達成協商，客戶願意提供實質補貼或承擔風險保障，相關漲價成本皆能順利轉嫁給客戶，毛利表現不會受負面影響。
Q4：北美其他大型 CSP 客戶的進展？
回答： 北美所有 CSP 客戶均為目標客戶。今年很高興能證實，除了既有主客戶外，在另外兩家 CSP 客戶處均已有電源（如 PSU、BBU）與機櫃（Rack）產品正式量產出貨；目標是未來各 Key Account 都能達成 10 億美元（1 Billion USD）級別的營收貢獻。
Q5：策略投資新加坡 DenseLight 的細節、定位與財務狀況？
回答： DenseLight 為擁有 20 年歷史的 private IDM 公司，專精於 InP（磷化銦）磊晶與製程，生產非中國供應鏈的 CW Laser 等關鍵組件。光寶科持股 21%，透過光寶後端光學封裝與模組整合能力，結合其晶片源頭技術進行垂直整合。該投資產品預計將在 2027~2028 年對光寶科產生顯著的 CPO / 光引擎模組營收貢獻。
Q6：800V HVDC Power Rack 的驗證與量產時程是否有變動？ (分析師)
回答： 時程並無變動。預計 8 月份產出 Sample 機型送交客戶並開展 13 週第一階段測試，隨後進入與 IT 系統對接的第二階段驗證。若一切順利，預估 11 月進入少量量產，較大規模放量將落在 2027 年第一季。
Q7：資本支出高達 180 億元，是否會影響未來的股利發放或需要額外籌資？ (關先生 / 分析師)
回答： 未來 CapEx 規模不太會超越今年的高點。今年為投資高峰主因是一次性添購 High-Power 新產品所需的研發與測試設備，以及高雄二期與越南廣寧新廠的初期建置費用。未來產能建置完成後將依需求彈性調整，不至於影響正常的股利發放政策。
Q8：併購南京 DCDC 團隊的目的與綜效？ (分析師)
回答： 南京該團隊以技術為主，具備被 CSP 客戶認可的高階 DC-DC 轉換器技術。隨著未來 HVDC 壓降架構門檻拉高（如從 800V 直接降至高瓦數微電壓），技術難度大幅增加。結合該團隊技術與光寶科的規模平臺，能為 CSP 及 Enterprise 客戶提供更完整的能源管理方案。
Q9：2026 與 2027 年非中國產能擴充的比重？ (分析師)
回答： 2026 年非中國產能相較於 2025 年年增 1.62 倍；預計 2026 年底非中國產能佔比將突破 60%，到 2027 年非中國產能將進一步推升至 70%。
Q10：消費性與資訊電子市場下半年的展望？ (張經理 / 分析師)
回答： 整體終端市場下半年相對弱勢，需求甚至比先前預期更為疲軟。不過光寶科透過產品售價提升（反映成本）與價值提升，預期在資訊與消費性電子領域的營收仍可維繫持平表現，不致跟隨大盤大幅下滑。

paras_en: 1. Detailed Financial and Operational Information for Q2 2026
Financial Performance:
• Revenue and Profit: Q2 consolidated revenue reached NT$52.7 billion, up NT$213.14 million quarter‑over‑quarter and 126% year‑over‑year, setting a record high.
• First‑Half Cumulative: H1 consolidated revenue was NT$96.1 billion, up NT$254.80 million year‑over‑year, a 66% increase, with all profit metrics reaching all‑time highs.
• Dividend Policy: The board approved a cash dividend of NT$2.5 per share for Q2 2026.
Market Outlook and AI Demand:

• Transformation Results: The company has shifted from a traditional OEM/ODM model to a high‑value‑solution system integrator. Benefiting from strong demand for next‑generation AI data centers and the postponement of some high‑end model shipments from Q1 to Q2, the share and profit of high‑value businesses have risen.

• Cloud Business Strength: Cloud‑related revenue grew more than 70% year‑over‑year in Q2; the cloud and IoT segments accounted for 54% of H1 revenue, and AI‑related product revenue is expected to exceed 30% of total revenue by year‑end.

• Operational Outlook: For Q3, core businesses are expected to maintain strong quarterly and annual growth; the revenue split between the first and second halves of the year is projected at roughly 42‑45% versus 55‑58%.
Capital Allocation and Overseas Expansion:

• Capital Expenditure Increase: To meet rapid growth in AI and high‑end power supplies, full‑year 2026 CapEx was raised from the previously estimated NT$13 billion to NT$18 billion. About 70% will fund high‑power/AI‑specific R&D and test equipment, and the remaining 30% will go to plant and facility mechanical‑electrical construction.

• Global Capacity Layout: Phase‑2 of the Kaohsiung plant in Taiwan and the Guangning plant in Vietnam are slated for mass production in Q3 and Q4 respectively. A US$919 million investment in McKinney, Texas will break ground in mid‑August, obtain a usage license by the end of 2026, start trial production in Q1 2027 and commence full production in Q2 2027. Non‑China capacity is expected to exceed 60% by the end of 2026 and reach 70% in 2027.
Product Technology and Strategic Investments:

• AI Power and Rack Solutions: Next‑generation 110 kW Power Shelf, BBU (high‑efficiency backup battery system) and 800 V HVDC Power Rack will enter verification and mass‑production phases in the second half of the year; the 800 V HVDC Power Rack is scheduled for sample delivery in August, limited shipment in November, with volume production aimed at Q1 2027.

• Strategic Investment in Singapore’s DenseLight: The board approved a US$34.3 million investment to acquire a 21% stake and a board seat in DenseLight, a Singapore‑based InP photonic component maker. The partnership will combine DenseLight’s CWDM laser and gain‑chip technologies to target future 1.6 T/3.2 T optical engines, optical modules and CPO (co‑packaged optics) markets.
• Acquisition of Nanjing DCDC R&D Team: To secure advanced DC‑DC converter technology for upcoming high‑voltage‑direct‑current (HVDC) high‑power direct‑supply architectures.
Full Q&A List from the Lite‑On Technology Investor Conference:
Q1: Why did the Q2 gross margin rebound sharply? Did the Q1 inventory write‑down reverse?

A: There was a modest reversal of customer pull‑forward in Q2, but its impact was limited. The gross margin jumped to 27.2% mainly because some Q1 shipments were deferred to Q2, the share of high‑value cloud products rose sharply (nearly 70% growth), and economies of scale from global capacity took effect. Looking at the H1 overall margin of about 24.7%, the target is to keep gross margin above 25% and trend upward over the long term.
Q2: Details of the CapEx increase from NT$13 billion to NT$18 billion? Does it include the Texas plant?

A: The NT$18 billion figure already includes the US plant construction and expansion costs. Roughly 30% is allocated to land and building/expansion, and 70% to high‑spec R&D test equipment, automation and production‑line gear. AI high‑power products such as the Power Rack have completely different test specifications, requiring custom‑built equipment.
Q3: How is the company handling shortages and price hikes of key components (e.g., PCBs, semiconductors)?

A: The company adopts a strategic six‑month‑ahead procurement and stocking approach. The additional inventory has been negotiated with CSP customers, who are willing to provide subsidies or assume risk, allowing the price‑increase costs to be passed on to customers without hurting margin.
Q4: Progress with other large North American CSP customers?

A: All North American CSP customers are target accounts. This year we confirmed that, besides existing major customers, two additional CSP customers have begun mass production and shipment of power supplies (PSU, BBU) and rack products. The goal is for each key account to eventually contribute US$1 billion in revenue.
Q5: Details, positioning and financial outlook of the strategic investment in DenseLight?

A: DenseLight is a 20‑year‑old private IDM specializing in InP epitaxy and process, producing CW lasers and other components outside the China supply chain. Lite‑On holds 21% and will leverage its back‑end optical packaging and module integration capabilities to vertically integrate DenseLight’s chip technology. The investment is expected to generate significant CPO/optical‑engine module revenue for Lite‑On in 2027‑2028.
Q6: Any schedule changes for the 800 V HVDC Power Rack verification and mass production? (Analyst)

A: No schedule change. Samples are planned for August, followed by a 13‑week first‑stage test, then a second‑stage verification with IT system integration. If all goes well, limited production should start in November, with large‑scale volume in Q1 2027.
Q7: With CapEx at NT$18 billion, will dividend payouts be affected or will additional financing be needed? (Mr. Guan / Analyst)

A: Future CapEx is unlikely to exceed this year’s peak. This year’s spending is a one‑time peak driven by the purchase of R&D and test equipment for new high‑power products and the initial build‑out of Kaohsiung Phase‑2 and Guangning plants. Once capacity is in place, spending will be adjusted flexibly to demand, so dividend policy will remain unaffected.
Q8: Purpose and synergies of acquiring the Nanjing DCDC team? (Analyst)

A: The Nanjing team is technology‑focused, possessing high‑end DC‑DC converter expertise recognized by CSP customers. As HVDC step‑down architectures become more demanding (e.g., dropping directly from 800 V to high‑power micro‑volt levels), technical difficulty rises sharply. Combining this team’s technology with Lite‑On’s scale will enable more complete energy‑management solutions for CSP and enterprise customers.
Q9: Share of non‑China capacity in 2026 and 2027? (Analyst)
A: Non‑China capacity in 2026 is 1.62 times that of 2025; it is expected to exceed 60% of total capacity by year‑end 2026 and rise to 70% in 2027.
Q10: Outlook for consumer and information‑electronics markets in the second half of the year? (Manager Zhang / Analyst)

A: The overall end‑user market is relatively weak in the second half, with demand softer than previously expected. However, Lite‑On plans to maintain flat revenue in the information and consumer electronics segments by raising product prices (reflecting higher costs) and delivering added value, avoiding a steep decline alongside the broader market.

items.title: 離岸風電面臨多重挑戰 台灣風力發電產業協會理事長許逸德提四大建言
items.title_en: Offshore Wind Faces Multiple Challenges; Taiwan Wind Power Industry Association Chairman Hsu I‑teh Offers Four Key Recommendations
paras: 台灣風力發電發展協會今 (31) 日舉辦會員大會暨尖峰論壇，華城 (1519-TW) 總經理、同時也是協會理事長的許逸德與風電業界同步指出，可預測性、可融資、可執行與供應鏈韌性為推動離岸產業發展的重要基礎。
離岸風電 3-3 期選商在即，許逸德表示，3-3 期不僅是新一輪選商，更攸關國家能源安全、綠電供應及本土供應鏈的永續發展。
而台灣風力發電產業發展協會同步舉辦「離岸風電 R3-3 期區塊開發選商機制下專案控管與風險管理論壇」，並邀集開發商、風機商、統包商與設備商對話。面對全球高利率、供應連重組與 2030 年前後大量風場集中併網等挑戰，風電業界提出四大政策建言，呼籲政府打造穩定、透明且可預測的市場機制，作為推動台灣離岸風電下一階段發展的基礎。
首先業界呼籲，必須有穩定且連續性的案場釋出，是支撐投資信心與供應鏈持續投入的關鍵，也提升市場可預測性；第二，面臨全球高利率與資本市場變化，須有完整的融資制度，建議優化融資保證與金融支持機制，降低開發風險，吸引更多國內外資金投入台灣離岸風電市場。
第三，業界表示，未來大量風場集中施工與併網，將對工程人力、施工船舶、港口、設備及電網資源帶來壓力，建議優化併網與行政協調，提升專案執行效率；最後，業界認為，台灣離岸風電已建立完整的在地供應鏈，因此須強化供應鏈韌性，提升國際競爭力。
許逸德也再度重申，離岸風電產業真正的挑戰並非裝置容量大小，而是可預測性、可融資、可執行與供應鏈韌性四大關鍵。
台灣風力發電產業協會今天也同步改選理監事，新任理事長將由東元 (1504-TW) 副董事長吳素秋接任。
paras_en: The Taiwan Wind Power Development Association held its member meeting and peak forum today (31st). Hsu I‑teh, General Manager of Hua Cheng (1519‑TW) and also the association’s chairman, together with the wind power industry highlighted that predictability, financing, execution, and supply‑chain resilience are essential foundations for advancing the offshore sector.

Hsu noted that the upcoming Phase 3‑3 offshore wind tender is not only a new round of vendor selection but also crucial for national energy security, green‑power supply, and the sustainable development of the domestic supply chain.

The association concurrently organized a “Offshore Wind R3‑3 Phase Block Development Tender Mechanism Project Control and Risk Management Forum,” inviting developers, turbine manufacturers, EPC contractors and equipment suppliers to dialogue. Confronted with global high interest rates, supply‑chain restructuring and the massive concentration and grid‑integration of wind farms around 2030, the industry put forward four policy recommendations, urging the government to create a stable, transparent and predictable market mechanism as the basis for the next stage of Taiwan’s offshore wind development.

First, the industry calls for a stable and continuous release of project sites, which underpins investor confidence, sustains supply‑chain participation and enhances market predictability.; Second, amid global high rates and shifting capital markets, a comprehensive financing framework is needed; the industry suggests optimizing financing guarantees and financial support mechanisms to lower development risk and attract more domestic and foreign capital into Taiwan’s offshore wind market.; Third, the industry warns that the upcoming large‑scale, concentrated construction and grid‑integration of wind farms will strain engineering labor, installation vessels, ports, equipment and grid resources, and recommends streamlining grid‑connection and administrative coordination to improve project execution efficiency.; Fourth, the industry asserts that Taiwan’s offshore wind sector has built a complete local supply chain, but it must strengthen supply‑chain resilience to boost international competitiveness.

Hsu reiterated that the real challenges for the offshore wind industry are not the size of installed capacity but the four key pillars of predictability, financing, execution and supply‑chain resilience.
The Taiwan Wind Power Development Association also held elections for its board and supervisory directors today; the new chairman will be Wu Su‑chiu, Vice Chairman of TECO (1504‑TW).

items.title: 進泰電子營收轉爲正成長 宣布完成現增籌資2.1億元
items.title_en: Jin Tai Electronics Reports Positive Revenue Growth and Announces Completion of a 210 Million TWD Capital Increase
paras: 音訊產品供應商進泰電子 (3465-TW) 以發行 7000 張現增股自市場籌資，此一現增案以每股 30 元溢價發行，今 (31) 日宣布完成完成募集並自市場籌資 2.1 億元，進泰電子現增預計 8 月 5 日上櫃交易。
同時，進泰電子度過第一季的新事業及開發新機種陣痛期，2026 年第二季業績表現向上，繼 4 月營收 1.94 億元後，5 月營收持續上攀進入近年高檔期，達 2.32 億元，年增 1.91 倍，第二季營收 6.17 億元，年增 57.49%，並可望轉盈。
進泰電子 2026 年 1-6 月營收 9.54 億元，較 2025 年同期成長轉正，年增 14.35%，將在 8 月 4 日公布最新財報。
進泰電子 2026 年第一季營收 3.37 億元，年減 23.84%、歸屬母公司達 3243 萬元的虧損，每股淨損達 0.92 元，主要因客戶旗艦新機工藝技術門檻高、AI 強潮影響電子關鍵零組件的穩定供應，以及首季中有春節長假等，影響整體產量，加上投入影音擴大機業務初期支出較高所造成。
進泰電子在越南產能成長，目前透過積極取得關鍵材料穩定料源，新機產製學習曲線已見成效，4 月起營收已回復成長軌道，目前工廠全線趕工並加開組裝線產能，去化客戶訂單，最差情況已過，隨著客戶訂單在旗艦機種出貨量增，也對第三季業績不看淡。
法人估，進泰電子 2026 年營運可望逐季攀高，進泰隨著影音擴大機產品出貨，將力拚 2027 年營運締造高峰。
paras_en: Audio product supplier Jin Tai Electronics (3465-TW) raised capital from the market by issuing 7,000 new shares at a premium of NT$30 per share, completing a fundraising of NT$210 million on the 31st. The capital increase is slated to begin trading on the OTC market on August 5.

At the same time, Jin Tai Electronics has moved past the first‑quarter pain of launching new businesses and developing new models. In the second quarter of 2026, performance improved: after April revenue of NT$194 million, May revenue climbed to NT$232 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 1.91 times. Second‑quarter revenue reached NT$617 million, up 57.49% year‑over‑year, and the company is expected to turn to profit.

Jin Tai Electronics' revenue for the first half of 2026 was NT$954 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 14.35% compared with the same period in 2025, and the latest financial results will be announced on August 4.

In the first quarter of 2026, revenue was NT$337 million, down 23.84% year‑over‑year, with a loss attributable to the parent company of NT$32.43 million, or a net loss per share of NT$0.92. The decline was mainly due to the high technical barriers of a flagship new device from a key customer, AI‑driven demand pressures on critical electronic components, a long Lunar New Year holiday that reduced overall output, and higher early‑stage expenses from expanding the audio‑visual equipment business.

Jin Tai Electronics' production capacity in Vietnam is growing. By actively securing key material supplies, the learning curve for the new product line has begun to show results, and revenue has been back on a growth trajectory since April. The factory has accelerated work across all lines and added assembly‑line capacity to fulfill customer orders; the worst‑case scenario has passed. As flagship device shipments increase, the outlook for the third quarter remains positive.

Analysts estimate that Jin Tai Electronics' operations in 2026 will continue to improve quarter by quarter, and with the expansion of its audio‑visual equipment shipments, the company aims to reach a performance peak in 2027.

研華第二季營收 261.26 億元，季增 28.16%、年增 46.48%、毛利率 37.68%，季減 1.46 個百分點、年減 2.31 個百分點、營業利益 51.27 億元，季增 37.52%、年增 64.17%、營業利益率 19.63%，季增 1.33 個百分點、年增 2.11 個百分點。
研華表示，上半年受惠於全球客戶加速 AI 布局，帶動相關應用需求持續暢旺，雖然第二季毛利率受到短期關鍵原物料價格波動影響下滑，但在營收規模放大下，單季、上半年獲利仍繳出強勁成長、改寫歷史新高。
