整體營運以區域別而言，北美、歐洲及新興市場均年增約 3 成，中國年增 51%、北亞年增 24%、台灣年增 67%；各事業群整體表現突出，智能系統年增 34%、物聯網自動化年增 19%、嵌入式事業群年增 28%、智能服務也有個位數年增。
paras_en: Industrial computer giant Advantech (2395‑TW) announced its second‑quarter results today (31st), reporting a post‑tax net profit of NT$4.518 billion, up 35.50% quarter‑over‑quarter and 127.15% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$5.20, a historic high. For the first half of the year, net profit reached NT$7.852 billion, up 66.25% YoY, and EPS was NT$9.05, also a record high for the same period.

Advantech’s Q2 revenue was NT$26.126 billion, up 28.16% QoQ and 46.48% YoY. Gross margin stood at 37.68%, down 1.46 percentage points QoQ and 2.31 points YoY. Operating profit was NT$5.127 billion, up 37.52% QoQ and 64.17% YoY, with an operating margin of 19.63%, an increase of 1.33 percentage points QoQ and 2.11 points YoY.

The company said the first half benefited from global customers accelerating AI deployments, which kept demand for related applications strong. Although Q2 gross margin slipped due to short‑term volatility in key raw‑material prices, the larger revenue base allowed both the quarter and the first half to deliver robust profit growth and set new historical highs.

For the first half of the year, Advantech recorded revenue of NT$46.512 billion, up 32.18% YoY, with a gross margin of 38.32% (down 1.92 percentage points YoY). Operating profit was NT$8.856 billion, up 46.44% YoY, and operating margin rose to 19.04%, an increase of 1.85 percentage points YoY.

By region, overall operations saw roughly 30% YoY growth in North America, Europe and emerging markets; China grew 51%, North Asia 24%, and Taiwan 67%. All business groups performed strongly: the Smart Systems segment grew 34%, IoT Automation 19%, Embedded Business 28%, and Smart Services posted single‑digit growth.

items.title: 砸41.5億強攻企業AI！繼微軟後OpenAI成立FDE「特種部隊」攜手BCG、貝恩構築頂級顧問網絡
items.title_en: Spending $4.15 Billion to Attack Enterprise AI! After Microsoft, OpenAI Launches FDE “Special Forces” and Teams Up with BCG, Bain to Build a Top‑Tier Consulting Network
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，在消費級 AI 應用趨於飽和之際，OpenAI 正以前所未有的力道轉向企業級市場，試圖填補尖端模型能力與企業實際應用之間的巨大鴻溝。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ)周五 (31 日) 報導，OpenAI 近期連出兩記重拳：成立獨立服務子公司「OpenAI Deployment Co.」(簡稱 DeployCo)，並斥資 1.5 億美元構建頂級諮詢夥伴網絡，雙管齊下搶占數千億美元的企業 AI 服務市場。
DeployCo 在 5 月正式掛牌，由 TPG 領投 40 億美元，Advent、貝恩資本、Brookfield 等巨頭聯合參投。該公司脫胎於 OpenAI 對 AI 諮詢公司 Tomoro 及應用開發商 Northslope 的連續收購，目前已集結數百名「前線部署工程師」(FDE)。這支被視為「特種部隊」的隊伍，將直接進駐企業客戶現場，將抽象的模型能力轉化為具體的業務流程。
DeployCo 技術長 Arnaud Fournier 說：「模型能力與人們實際使用之間的差距，從未像現在這樣巨大。」
以西班牙對外銀行 (BBVA) 為例，一名 FDE 協助該行重構信貸風險分析工具，引入 AI 智能體互評機制，使工具準確率從不足 60% 躍升至 80%。
OpenAI 內部 FDE 負責人 Colin Jarvis 指出，FDE 團隊通常嵌入客戶數月至數年，規模從一人到五人不等，涵蓋從概念驗證到全面部署的全週期。
然而，技術落地僅是難題的一半。顧能 (Gartner) 分析師 Arun Chandrasekaran 指出，AI 實驗室缺乏與董事會及「長字輩」高管對話的管道，難以推動深層次的組織變革。
因此，OpenAI 同步推出 1.5 億美元的合作夥伴計劃，將波士頓諮詢 (BCG)、貝恩、埃森哲等頂級諮詢巨頭納入生態系。
BCG 全球合作與聯盟負責人 Vikas Taneja 強調，諮詢公司的核心價值在於協助企業應對「變革管理」，像是如何調整組織架構、重塑工作流程、管理員工預期，以承接 AI 帶來的效率飛躍。
OpenAI 全球合作與生態副總裁 Colleen Kapase 說：「將先進模型轉化為真實業務價值，需要一個值得信賴的夥伴生態系統。」
TPG 合夥人 Peter McGoohan 預測，企業 AI 服務的可尋址市場規模最終將達數千億美元。
這場競賽已趨於白熱化。Anthropic 在 3 月推出類似的「應用 AI 團隊」及夥伴計畫，微軟與亞馬遜也相繼佈局 FDE 服務。
對於剛完成新一輪融資、亟需證明商業化能力的 OpenAI 而言，DeployCo 及其夥伴網絡不僅是技術落地的抓手，更是支撐其天價估值、對抗競爭對手的戰略護城河。企業 AI 的「最後一哩路」正成為巨頭們角力的新戰場。
paras_en: Foreign media reports note that as consumer‑grade AI applications approach saturation, OpenAI is shifting to the enterprise market with unprecedented force, aiming to bridge the huge gap between cutting‑edge model capabilities and real‑world business use.

The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday (the 31st) that OpenAI has dealt two heavy blows recently: it created an independent services subsidiary called OpenAI Deployment Co. (shortened to DeployCo) and is spending $150 million to build a top‑tier consulting partner network, a two‑pronged effort to capture the multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar enterprise AI services market.

DeployCo was officially launched in May, backed by a $4 billion lead investment from TPG, with Advent, Bain Capital, Brookfield and other giants co‑investing. The company emerged from OpenAI’s successive acquisitions of AI consulting firm Tomoro and application developer Northslope, and now has assembled hundreds of “Front‑line Deployment Engineers” (FDE). This team, described as a “special forces” unit, will go on‑site at corporate customers to turn abstract model capabilities into concrete business processes.
DeployCo’s chief technology officer Arnaud Fournier said, “The gap between model capabilities and what people actually use has never been this large.”

Taking Spain’s Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA) as an example, an FDE helped the bank revamp its credit‑risk analysis tool, introducing an AI‑agent peer‑review mechanism that lifted the tool’s accuracy from under 60 % to 80 %.

OpenAI’s internal FDE head Colin Jarvis noted that FDE teams typically embed with clients for months to years, ranging in size from one to five people, covering the full cycle from proof‑of‑concept to full deployment.

However, technology deployment is only half the challenge. Gartner analyst Arun Chandrasekaran pointed out that AI labs often lack channels to communicate with boards and senior‑level executives, making deep organizational change difficult to drive.
Therefore, OpenAI is simultaneously launching a $150 million partner program, bringing top consulting giants such as Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain, and Accenture into its ecosystem.

BCG’s global head of partnerships and alliances Vikas Taneja emphasized that a consulting firm’s core value lies in helping companies manage “change management”—adjusting organizational structures, redesigning workflows, and managing employee expectations to capture AI‑driven efficiency gains.
OpenAI’s vice‑president of global partnerships and ecosystem Colleen Kapase said, “Turning advanced models into real business value requires a trustworthy partner ecosystem.”
TPG partner Peter McGoohan predicts that the addressable market for enterprise AI services will ultimately reach several hundred billion dollars.
The race has heated up. Anthropic launched a similar “Application AI Team” and partner program in March, and Microsoft and Amazon have also rolled out FDE services.

For OpenAI, which has just completed a new financing round and is eager to prove its commercialization chops, DeployCo and its partner network are not only a means to implement technology but also a strategic moat supporting its sky‑high valuation and defending against rivals. The “last mile” of enterprise AI is becoming the new battlefield for the giants.

items.title: 慧榮與聯發科下周主題演講 聚焦新一代AI車用平台
items.title_en: Simo and MediaTek to Deliver Joint Keynote Next Week Focusing on Next‑Generation AI‑Ready Automotive Platform
paras: 慧榮科技 (SIMO-US) 今 (31) 日宣布，將與聯發科 (2454-TW) 於 FMS 2026 主題演講中，聚焦新一代 AI-Ready 車用平台。此次主題演講將結合聯發科最新車載座艙平台與慧榮先進的車用儲存技術，說明高效能、高可靠性的儲存解決方案如何滿足新一代智慧汽車日益成長的資料處理需求。
本場演講將於 8 月 4 日下午 2:20 在美國舉行，由慧榮 Edge SSD 產品事業部協理副總黃士德、聯發科車用系統架構總監 Waheed Ahmed，以及慧榮科技企業級產品行銷資深協理 Shamil Sharief 共同主講，分享智慧儲存技術如何支援新一代 AI 車用平台、代理式 AI 與 AI 基礎設施的發展，並探討智慧儲存架構在未來 AI 應用中的關鍵角色。
慧榮指出，隨著車用產業邁入實體 AI 時代，智慧車輛已成為最具代表性的邊緣 AI 應用之一，所產生與處理的資料量正以前所未有的速度成長。憑藉超過十年的車用市場深耕，公司已成為車用產業值得信賴的儲存技術合作夥伴，持續提供兼具高效能、低功耗、高安全性與高可靠性的儲存解決方案，滿足新一代 AI 定義汽車 (AI-defined Vehicles) 的需求。
慧榮正透過與全球領先汽車 OEM、Tier 1 供應商、SoC 合作夥伴及 NAND Flash 大廠的緊密合作，公司儲存技術已廣泛應用於全球 AI 智慧座艙與車載運算平台。
慧榮科技邊緣 SSD 產品事業部協理副總黃士德表示，隨著 AI 工作負載日益趨向資料密集化，儲存架構已成為智慧系統效能的核心基礎，從 AI 定義汽車到 AI 工廠皆是如此。透過與聯發科的合作，將分享先進儲存架構如何提供智慧化資料管理、可預測的效能表現，以及新一代 AI 定義汽車所需的高可靠性。
聯發科車用系統架構總監 Waheed Ahmed 表示，AI 正加速將汽車轉型為智慧運算平台，也對高效能、高可靠性的資料基礎架構提出全新要求。我們與慧榮科技的合作，充分展現先進運算與智慧儲存如何相輔相成，共同推動 AI-Ready 車輛的未來發展。
paras_en: Simo Technology (SIMO-US) announced today (31st) that it will join MediaTek (2454‑TW) for a keynote at FMS 2026, focusing on the next‑generation AI‑Ready automotive platform. The presentation will combine MediaTek’s latest in‑vehicle cockpit platform with Simo’s advanced automotive storage technology, illustrating how high‑performance, highly reliable storage solutions can meet the growing data‑processing demands of next‑generation smart cars.

The talk will be held on August 4 at 2:20 PM in the United States and will be co‑presented by Simo’s Deputy General Manager of the Edge SSD Business Unit, Huang Shide; MediaTek Automotive Systems Architecture Director Waheed Ahmed; and Simo’s Senior Associate Director of Enterprise Product Marketing, Shamil Sharief. They will discuss how intelligent storage technology supports next‑generation AI automotive platforms, agent‑based AI, and AI infrastructure development, and explore the critical role of smart storage architecture in future AI applications.

Simo notes that as the automotive industry enters the physical AI era, smart vehicles have become one of the most representative edge‑AI applications, with data generation and processing accelerating at unprecedented rates. With more than a decade of deep involvement in the automotive market, the company has become a trusted storage‑technology partner for the industry, continuously delivering solutions that combine high performance, low power, high security and high reliability to meet the needs of AI‑defined Vehicles.

Through close collaboration with global automotive OEMs, Tier‑1 suppliers, SoC partners and major NAND‑Flash manufacturers, Simo’s storage technology is now widely deployed in AI‑enabled cockpits and in‑vehicle compute platforms worldwide.

Simo’s Deputy General Manager of the Edge SSD Business Unit, Huang Shide, said that as AI workloads become increasingly data‑intensive, storage architecture has become the core foundation of smart‑system performance—from AI‑defined cars to AI factories. By partnering with MediaTek, they will share how advanced storage architectures provide intelligent data management, predictable performance, and the high reliability required by next‑generation AI‑defined vehicles.

MediaTek Automotive Systems Architecture Director Waheed Ahmed stated that AI is accelerating the transformation of cars into smart computing platforms, creating new demands for high‑performance, highly reliable data infrastructure. The collaboration with Simo demonstrates how advanced compute and intelligent storage complement each other to drive the future of AI‑Ready vehicles.

items.title: 上車在即！阿里千問已在特斯拉車機內測
items.title_en: Boarding Soon! Alibaba's Qianwen Already in Tesla In‑Car System Testing
paras: 多位知情人士透露，阿里千問已進入特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 中國車機的深度測試階段，上車在即。
千問已經在特斯拉真實車機環境下完成大量上車測試工作，「能聽能答、能控車、能導航、能辦事，都已經在計畫內」。
據《科創板日報》31 日（周五）報導，未來千問在特斯拉車機上能提供的能力，可能遠超單一「語音助手」的定義。
2026 北京車展上，中國一線車廠已經宣布陸續接入千問，從揭露的技術路線來看，千問上車至少具備三層能力：
一是複雜語義與多任務路徑規劃；
二是打通「點單—履約—支付」的辦事閉環；
三是端雲協同架構下，覆蓋內容、生活、交易全場景。
對於千問何時正式上車，截至發稿，阿里雲與特斯拉中國均未正式回應。
paras_en: Multiple insiders say Alibaba's Qianwen has entered the deep testing phase on Tesla (TSLA-US) Chinese in‑car systems, with deployment imminent.

Qianwen has already completed extensive on‑vehicle testing in real Tesla infotainment environments, and "listening and answering, vehicle control, navigation, and task handling are all within the plan."
According to the Science and Innovation Board Daily on the 31st (Friday), the capabilities Qianwen may offer on Tesla's in‑car system could far exceed the definition of a single "voice assistant."

At the 2026 Beijing Auto Show, leading Chinese automakers announced they would gradually integrate Qianwen. Based on the disclosed technical roadmap, Qianwen's on‑vehicle deployment includes at least three layers of capability: (1) complex semantics and multi‑task path planning; (2) a closed loop for ordering, fulfillment, and payment; and (3) under a edge‑cloud collaborative architecture, coverage of content, lifestyle, and transaction scenarios across the board.
As for when Qianwen will officially be on board, as of this publication, neither Alibaba Cloud nor Tesla China has responded formally.

items.title: 黃仁勳自爆「超內向」：沒有開源就沒今天的AI  記憶體已成AI最大瓶頸
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Reveals He's "Super Introverted": No Open Source, No Today's AI; Memory Has Become AI's Biggest Bottleneck
paras: 輝達創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳週一 (27 日) 出席「Y Combinator」播客節目時談到對 AI 的看法和理念，並談及個人人生觀。
在聊完 Waymo 自動駕駛汽車後，主持人說：「我想藉這個機會稍稍停一下。我們這裡正好有一群觀眾，或許台下的你們可以歡迎黃仁勳加入 X 平台，他應該也發了自己的第一條帖子。」
黃仁勳上周五 (24 日) 正式入駐 X 平台，發布的首條帖文是輝達簽署的公開信，主要講述開源模型為何重要。「世界需要先進閉源模型，也需要先進開源模型。」
黃仁勳對此回應稱：「你知道的，這恰好說明了我有多麼內向。我 2026 年才在 X 平台發布第一條貼文，也可能是地球上最後一個這麼做的人，但我要發的東西實在是太重要了，對整個行業、整個世界來說都很重要。所以我才克服自己的害羞，終於在 X 上發布了第一條內容。」
他繼續說道：「如果沒有開源，行動互聯網和雲端運算產業根本不存在。如果沒有開放生態、沒有 Linux、Kubernetes、TensorFlow、PyTorch，我不敢想現在會怎樣。你要知道，所有這些東西都是開源的。如果沒有這些，我們怎麼可能在今天擁抱 AI？」
黃仁勳周一也指出，記憶體晶片已成為 AI 發展的最大瓶頸。隨著 AI 任務向複雜智能體與情境處理演進，HBM 對資料儲存與快速檢索的關鍵性日益凸顯。
此前，輝達靠著 GPU 奠定 AI 算力優勢，如今已轉向構建集成記憶體晶片的系統，需依賴美光、SK 海力士及三星等供應商的穩定大批量供應，但專用記憶體晶片產能有限，供應受限可能衝擊輝達的產品交付速度。
市場人士則分析認為，此為 AI 演進自然階段，輝達仍具長期主導潛力。
paras_en: Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang appeared on a Y Combinator podcast on Monday (the 27th) to discuss his views and philosophy on AI as well as his personal outlook on life.

After talking about Waymo's self‑driving cars, the host said, "I’d like to take a brief pause. We have an audience here, and maybe those of you in the room can welcome Jensen Huang to the X platform; he should have just posted his first tweet there."

Jensen Huang officially joined X last Friday (the 24th) and his first post was a public letter signed by Nvidia that explained why open‑source models matter. "The world needs advanced closed‑source models, and it also needs advanced open‑source models," it said.

Huang responded, "You know, that just shows how introverted I am. I only posted my first thing on X in 2026, and I might be the last person on Earth to do that, but what I have to share is just too important—for the whole industry and the world. So I pushed past my shyness and finally posted my first content on X."

He continued, "If there were no open source, the mobile internet and cloud computing industries would not exist. If there were no open ecosystems, no Linux, Kubernetes, TensorFlow, PyTorch, I can’t imagine what things would be like today. You have to understand that all of those are open source. Without them, how could we be embracing AI today?"

On Monday, Huang also pointed out that memory chips have become the biggest bottleneck for AI development. As AI tasks evolve toward more complex agents and contextual processing, the importance of HBM for data storage and rapid retrieval is becoming increasingly evident.

Previously, Nvidia built its AI compute advantage on GPUs; now it is shifting to building systems that integrate memory chips, relying on steady, high‑volume supply from suppliers such as Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung. However, dedicated memory chip capacity is limited, and supply constraints could affect Nvidia’s product delivery speed.
Market analysts say this is a natural stage in AI’s evolution and that Nvidia still has long‑term dominant potential.

items.title: 繼OpenAI後再爆資安危機！Claude設錯外網權限 駭入三家公司
items.title_en: Another Security Crisis After OpenAI! Claude Misconfigured External Network Access Leads to Hacks of Three Companies
paras: Anthropic 周四 (30 日) 表示，旗下人工智慧 (AI) 模型 Claude 因為設定錯誤，在測試期間取得網際網路存取權限，進而入侵了三家公司的系統，這是繼競爭對手 OpenAI 入侵 Hugging Face 之後，AI 引發的最新資安事件。
Anthropic 表示，原本應與外部網路隔離的測試環境，因設定錯誤讓 Claude 模型得以連上網際網路，並對三家機構的系統進行未經授權的存取。
OpenAI 上周披露 AI 代理在安全測試期間失控並入侵 Hugging Face 基礎設施之後，Anthropic 展開全面審查並檢視 14 萬 1006 次測試紀錄，最終發現此事。
這些事件凸顯出 AI 能力快速提升所帶來的資安風險，已從專家過去擔憂的理論情境演變為現實，就連頂尖 AI 開發商也可能因模型利用系統漏洞而措手不及。
Anthropic 表示，Claude 利用弱密碼及未經身分驗證的端點等基本手法，成功入侵受影響公司的基礎設施。這起事件涉及三個不同模型，包括 Claude Opus 4.7、Claude Mythos 5 及一款內部研究模型。最早案例可追溯至今年 4 月，都發生在缺乏 Anthropic 所稱「標準防護措施」的測試環境中。
這些入侵發生於俗稱「Capture the Flag」(CTF，奪旗攻防) 的資安演練。該測試要求 AI 模型在模擬網路中尋找隱藏資訊。Anthropic 表示，測試提示明確告知模型無法連接網際網路，但由於與合作測試夥伴 Irregular 間出現溝通誤解，實際測試環境仍連接至公共網路。
Anthropic 從 7 月 23 日開始檢視測試紀錄，並在同日發現 Claude 可能已連上網路後，立即暫停所有資安測試。該公司已在 7 月 24 日前確認總計共三起事件，並於 7 月 27 日通知受影響機構。
Anthropic 指出，其中兩家公司在接獲通知前並不知道遭到存取，目前仍持續聯繫第三家受影響機構。
Anthropic 表示，隨著 AI 模型愈來愈具備執行真實世界網路攻擊的能力，無論企業內部或第三方測試環境，都必須建立更嚴格的安全控管機制。
paras_en: Anthropic said on Thursday (the 30th) that its artificial intelligence (AI) model Claude mistakenly gained internet access during testing, allowing it to breach the systems of three companies. This follows a rival AI security incident in which OpenAI’s agents infiltrated Hugging Face’s infrastructure.

Anthropic explained that a test environment that should have been isolated from external networks was misconfigured, letting the Claude model connect to the internet and perform unauthorized access to the systems of three organizations.

After OpenAI disclosed last week that an AI agent went rogue during a security test and compromised Hugging Face’s infrastructure, Anthropic conducted a comprehensive review of 141,006 test logs and ultimately uncovered the incident.

These events highlight the cybersecurity risks posed by rapidly advancing AI capabilities, turning what experts once warned as theoretical scenarios into reality, and showing that even top AI developers can be caught off‑guard by models exploiting system vulnerabilities.

Anthropic said Claude used basic techniques such as weak passwords and unauthenticated endpoints to successfully infiltrate the affected companies’ infrastructure. The breach involved three different models: Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Mythos 5, and an internal research model. The earliest case dates back to April of this year, all occurring in test environments lacking what Anthropic calls “standard protective measures.”

The intrusions took place during a security exercise commonly known as “Capture the Flag” (CTF). The test required the AI model to locate hidden information within a simulated network. Anthropic noted that the test instructions explicitly told the model it could not access the internet, but a communication misunderstanding with testing partner Irregular resulted in the environment remaining connected to the public internet.

Anthropic began reviewing test logs on July 23 and, upon discovering that Claude might have connected to the internet that same day, immediately halted all security testing. The company confirmed a total of three incidents by July 24 and notified the affected organizations on July 27.
Anthropic indicated that two of the companies were unaware they had been accessed until they received the notification, and it is still in contact with the third affected organization.

Anthropic warned that as AI models become increasingly capable of carrying out real‑world network attacks, stricter security controls must be established in both internal corporate environments and third‑party testing setups.

items.title: AI晶片產能快被搶光！供應鏈進入「預付款時代」：簽千億美元鎖定 半導體權力格局正在重塑
items.title_en: AI Chip Capacity Is Being Snatched Up! The Supply Chain Enters a “Pre‑Payment Era”: Trillions of Dollars Locked In, Semiconductor Power Dynamics Are Being Reshaped
paras: 全球 AI 晶片的競爭已經超越單純的架構與算力比拼，悄然下沉至供應鏈深處一場關於「稀缺產能」的隱秘戰爭。
從晶圓代工、HBM、先進封裝到硅光材料，未來三到五年的核心產能正被重量級企業以預付款、長約 (LTA) 甚至股權投資的形式大規模鎖定，這不僅標誌著傳統買賣關係的終結，更預示著半導體產業權力格局的根本性重構。
從輝達累計高達 1190 億美元的供應鏈承諾，到美光的 16 份戰略客戶協議，再到三星與博通開創的「記憶體 + 代工 + 封裝」一體化交付，Soitec 的矽光材料供給所收取的預付款，無不證明產能已不再是買賣關係，而是戰略資產。
為了鎖定產能，廠商們正在各出奇招，而所謂的「預付款時代」，本質是一場全行業參與的「產能劃界運動」，下游客戶透過真金白銀的深度綁定，換取未來數年的產能優先權與技術話語權。
輝達堪稱此中模範。截至今年 4 月，其製造與供應承諾總額高達 1190 億美元，其中 950 億美元將於當前財年支付，本月也再與封測巨頭 Amkor 簽署 15 億美元協議，提供預付款助其擴充美國先進封裝產能，並協調技術路線圖。
這種策略早已延伸至光互連領域；輝達向 Coherent 投資 20 億美元，並簽署數十億美元採購協議，鎖定未來產能，其競爭壁壘已從 CUDA 軟體生態擴展至動用現金組織供應鏈的系統能力。
記憶體大廠則選擇以合約鎖定未來。美光已簽署 16 份「照付不議」(Take-or-Pay) 戰略客戶協議，剩餘履約義務約 1000 億美元，並收取約 180 億美元現金預付款，鎖定未來 20% 的 DRAM 與三分之一的 NAND 產量。這些設有價格上下限的協議，料將佔美光總營收 50% 以上，極大增強其定價權與抗週期能力。
SK 海力士同樣跟 10 家左右客戶簽下五年長約，該公司 HBM4 出貨放量助推上半年營收首破 100 兆韓元，大幅年增 257%。
最具顛覆性的是三星與博通的合作。雙方於 7 月簽署備忘錄，打算到 2030 年在記憶體、代工、封裝領域投入超 2000 億美元，這打破了傳統採購模式。
過去，博通必須分別向不同廠商採購邏輯晶片、HBM 並外包封裝，如今三星憑藉其獨有的「端到端」半導體能力，提供涵蓋 2 奈米製程、2.5D/3D 集成的「一體化交付」，這標誌著長期綁定已從單點產能，升級為整條 AI 晶片製造體系的深度融合。
綁定潮更向上游蔓延。矽光材料龍頭 Soitec 披露，其光子 SOI 銷售額年增率翻倍，正收取客戶預付款以擴產，這釋放出強烈信號：即便共封裝光學 (CPO) 尚未放量，其核心基材產能已被提前預訂。

驅動變革的是，AI 晶片形態與產業邏輯的根本轉變；一，AI 加速器已成為高度複雜的系統工程，涉及先進製程、HBM、2.5D/3D 封裝、矽光晶片等多個環節，任一環節缺料皆可導致整線停擺。台積電董事長魏哲家坦言，先進封裝產能緊張已限制客戶增長，並因此將 2026 年資本開支上調至 600 億美元以上，其中一成至兩成投向封裝測試；二，AI 產能日益專用化，HBM 堆疊、封裝設計、測試程序均需與特定客戶協同定制，供應商不敢僅憑市場預測盲目擴產；三，晶片迭代速度與建廠週期嚴重錯配，迫使客戶以長約換取供應確定性。
專家分析指出，新法則正在重塑產業生態。對上游廠商而言，預付款帶來擴產資金、穩定稼動率與可預測現金流，但也犧牲了現貨價格暴漲時的利潤彈性，並加深對重量級客戶的依賴。
對輝達、博通等巨頭，鎖定產能意味著確保出貨節奏、掌握技術定義權，但必須承擔需求不及預期時的合約違約風險與鉅額資金佔用。
衝擊最大的恐怕是中小晶片企業。當主要大廠以五年合約和百億預付款圈定核心資源後，中小公司可能面臨無產能可買、價高者得、交期延長甚至被迫使用落後製程困境。「設計出晶片」已不再是唯一門檻，能否憑藉資產負債表鎖定供應鏈，正成為新的生死線。
至於長約是否會終結半導體週期，專家給出否定答案，認為長約僅改變了風險表現形式。從過去的庫存積壓、價格暴跌，轉為未來的合約重談、預付款減值與產能閒置。
更需警惕的是「重複預訂」風險，客戶為防缺貨可能向多家供應商過度下單，誤導全行業擴產。魏哲家表示，台積電如今不僅聽取客戶需求數字，更核查數據中心建設進度與電力部署，以防晶片最終變為庫存。
值得注意的是，客戶正成為半導體擴產的第四類出資人，與企業現金流、銀行借貸、政府補貼並列。這種深度的資本與產能同盟，恐將推動 AI 晶片產業從「市場驅動」的週期性波動，轉向「資本綁定」的結構性競爭新時代。在這場靜水流深的變革中，贏家通吃局面恐將加速到來。
paras_en: Global competition for AI chips has moved beyond pure architecture and compute power battles and has quietly sunk into the depths of the supply chain, where a hidden war over “scarce capacity” is unfolding.

From wafer foundries, HBM, advanced packaging to silicon‑photonic materials, the core capacity for the next three to five years is being locked down on a massive scale by heavyweight players through pre‑payments, long‑term agreements (LTAs) and even equity investments. This not only marks the end of traditional buyer‑seller relationships but also signals a fundamental reshaping of the semiconductor industry’s power structure.

From Nvidia’s cumulative $119 billion supply‑chain commitments, to Micron’s 16 strategic‑customer agreements, to Samsung and Broadcom’s pioneering “memory + foundry + packaging” integrated delivery, and to the pre‑payments Soitec receives for its silicon‑photonic materials, all evidence that capacity is no longer a simple trade item but a strategic asset.

To lock in capacity, vendors are resorting to all sorts of tactics. The so‑called “pre‑payment era” is essentially an industry‑wide “capacity demarcation movement,” where downstream customers bind themselves with real cash to secure priority access and technical influence for the coming years.

Nvidia is a prime example. By April this year, its manufacturing and supply commitments totalled $119 billion, with $95 billion payable in the current fiscal year. This month it also signed a $1.5 billion deal with packaging giant Amkor, providing pre‑payment to help expand advanced packaging capacity in the United States and to coordinate the technology roadmap.

The strategy has already extended into the optical‑interconnect space; Nvidia invested $2 billion in Coherent and signed multi‑billion‑dollar purchase agreements to lock in future capacity, expanding its competitive moat from the CUDA software ecosystem to a cash‑driven ability to organize the supply chain.

Memory giants are opting for contract‑based capacity locks. Micron has signed 16 “take‑or‑pay” strategic‑customer agreements covering roughly $100 billion of remaining obligations and has collected about $18 billion in cash pre‑payments, securing 20% of future DRAM and one‑third of NAND output. These price‑capped contracts are expected to account for more than 50% of Micron’s total revenue, greatly enhancing its pricing power and cyclicality resilience.
SK Hynix has similarly signed five‑year LTAs with around ten customers; its HBM4 shipments surged, helping first‑half revenue break the 100 trillion‑won mark, a year‑over‑year increase of 257%.

The most disruptive development is the Samsung‑Broadcom partnership. In July the two signed a memorandum of understanding to invest over $200 billion by 2030 in memory, foundry and packaging, breaking away from traditional procurement models.

Historically Broadcom had to source logic chips, HBM and outsource packaging from different suppliers. Now Samsung, leveraging its unique end‑to‑end semiconductor capabilities, offers an integrated delivery covering 2‑nm processes and 2.5D/3D integration, marking a shift from single‑point capacity binding to deep integration across the entire AI‑chip manufacturing ecosystem.

The binding trend is moving upstream. Soitec, a leader in silicon‑photonic materials, disclosed that its photonic‑SOI sales grew at a double‑digit annual rate and that it is taking pre‑payments from customers to expand capacity. This sends a strong signal: even though co‑packaged optics (CPO) has not yet scaled, the core substrate capacity is already being pre‑booked.

The driver of this change is the fundamental transformation of AI‑chip form factors and industry logic. First, AI accelerators have become highly complex system‑engineered products involving advanced nodes, HBM, 2.5D/3D packaging and silicon‑photonic chips; a shortage at any link can halt the entire line. TSMC chairman Wei Zhejia admitted that tight advanced‑packaging capacity is limiting customer growth, prompting the company to raise its 2026 capital expenditure to over $60 billion, with 10‑20% earmarked for packaging and testing. Second, AI capacity is becoming increasingly specialized; HBM stacking, package design and test flows must be co‑developed with specific customers, so suppliers cannot blindly expand based on market forecasts. Third, the mismatch between chip iteration speed and fab construction cycles forces customers to use long‑term contracts to secure supply certainty.

Experts say new rules are reshaping the ecosystem. For upstream firms, pre‑payments provide expansion capital, stable utilization and predictable cash flow, but they sacrifice profit flexibility when spot prices spike and deepen dependence on heavyweight customers.

For giants like Nvidia and Broadcom, locking capacity ensures shipment cadence and control over technical definitions, but also exposes them to contract‑default risk and large capital lock‑up if demand falls short of expectations.

The biggest impact will likely be on small‑ and medium‑size chip companies. Once the majors lock core resources with five‑year contracts and billions in pre‑payments, SMEs may find no capacity to buy, face higher prices, longer lead times or be forced to use older processes. Designing a chip is no longer the sole hurdle; the ability to lock the supply chain with balance‑sheet strength becomes a new survival line.

Will long‑term contracts end the semiconductor cycle? Experts say no; they merely change the risk profile. Instead of inventory build‑ups and price crashes, the future will see contract renegotiations, pre‑payment impairments and idle capacity.

Another risk is “double‑booking”: customers may over‑order from multiple suppliers to avoid shortages, misleading the whole industry into over‑expansion. Wei Zhejia noted that TSMC now not only listens to customer demand numbers but also verifies data‑center construction progress and power‑deployment plans to prevent chips from ending up as excess inventory.

It is noteworthy that customers are becoming the fourth type of investor in semiconductor capacity expansion, alongside corporate cash flow, bank loans and government subsidies. This deep capital‑capacity alliance could push the AI‑chip industry from a market‑driven cyclical model toward a structurally competitive “capital‑bound” era. In this subtle yet profound transformation, a winner‑takes‑all landscape may accelerate rapidly.

items.title: 美股四巨頭持續加碼燒錢 2026年AI資本支出預計破7000億美元
items.title_en: U.S. Tech Giants Keep Burning Cash; 2026 AI Capex Expected to Exceed $700 Billion
paras: 隨著人工智慧 (AI) 算力競賽持續升溫，美股科技巨頭紛紛上調其資本支出指引，將資金集中投入於 AI 伺服器、資料中心及自研晶片等基礎建設。根據最新財報顯示，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 及 Meta(META-US) 四大巨頭在 2026 年的資本支出總額預計將逼近 7500 億美元，遠超去年的 4558 億美元規模。

亞馬遜與微軟領跑支出計畫

在支出規模方面，亞馬遜展現出強大的擴張野心。其執行長 Andy Jassy 在財報會議上表示，算力供需失衡的情況預計將延續至 2028 年，並宣布將全年資本支出上調至 2200 億美元。亞馬遜旗下的 AWS 雲端業務第二季表現亮眼，營收年增 37% 創下 18 個季度以來新高，AI 業務年化收入已突破 250 億美元。
微軟與 Alphabet 也不遑多讓。微軟維持約 1900 億美元的支出規劃，單季資本支出年增 70%，主要用於擴建 Azure 算力集群。Alphabet 則將 2026 年資本支出預計範圍提高至 1750 億至 2050 億美元。Meta 則預計支出 1150 億至 1350 億美元，用於加速資料中心建設，包括德州與路易斯安那州的超算園區項目。

獲利能力成為關注焦點

儘管基礎設施投入龐大，但投資人開始檢視這些投資能否轉化為實質收益。Forrester 分析師 Tracy Woo 指出，微軟的龐大投資已開始展現回報，帶動股價反彈。相較之下，Meta 由於缺乏對外銷售算力的雲端業務，AI 投入主要依靠廣告變現，導致第二季自由現金流年減 91%，引發市場對其「燒錢」速度的擔憂。
此外，Google 財務長 Anat Ashkenazi 表示，Google Cloud 積壓訂單超過 5140 億美元，顯示算力缺口短期內難以填補。而 Apple 雖未大規模自建資料中心，但持續加碼端側 AI 晶片研發，並面臨晶片供應鏈短缺的挑戰。

能源與硬體需求激增

這波支出浪潮對上游供應鏈產生顯著影響。摩根士丹利指出，AI 投資熱度正從晶片製造端向雲端廠商及落地應用端擴散。大量資料中心的興建對 GPU 可用性及電力資源造成壓力，甚至與加密貨幣礦工產生電力競爭。
對於市場的劇烈波動，全球最大資管公司貝萊德 (BlackRock) 認為，市場對近期科技股的拋售屬於「反應過度」。貝萊德強調，AI 競爭格局的轉變不代表投資崩潰，更便宜的 AI 反而會加速各行業應用普及，進而推高對基礎設施的整體需求。
paras_en: As the AI compute race heats up, U.S. tech giants are repeatedly raising their capital‑expenditure guidance, funneling money into AI servers, data centers and custom chips. According to the latest earnings reports, Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Meta (META‑US) together are projected to spend nearly $750 billion on capex in 2026, far above last year’s $455.8 billion.
Amazon and Microsoft Lead the Spending Plans

In terms of spend, Amazon shows the strongest expansion ambition. CEO Andy Jassy said at the earnings call that the imbalance between AI compute supply and demand is expected to persist until 2028, and announced that the company is raising its full‑year capex to $220 billion. Amazon’s AWS cloud business posted a stellar second‑quarter performance, with revenue up 37% year‑over‑year to a 18‑quarter high, and AI revenue now exceeding $25 billion on an annualized basis.

Microsoft and Alphabet are not far behind. Microsoft is maintaining a roughly $190 billion capex plan, with quarterly capex up 70% year‑over‑year, mainly to expand Azure compute clusters. Alphabet has lifted its 2026 capex outlook to a range of $175 billion‑$205 billion. Meta forecasts spending of $115 billion‑$135 billion to accelerate data‑center construction, including super‑computing park projects in Texas and Louisiana.
Profitability Becomes a Focus

Despite the massive infrastructure outlays, investors are scrutinizing whether these investments will translate into real earnings. Forrester analyst Tracy Woo noted that Microsoft’s huge spend is already showing returns, lifting its stock price. By contrast, Meta, lacking a cloud business that sells compute externally, relies on ad monetization for its AI spend, resulting in a 91% year‑over‑year decline in second‑quarter free cash flow and raising concerns about its cash‑burn rate.

In addition, Google CFO Anat Ashkenazi said Google Cloud has a backlog of orders exceeding $514 billion, indicating that the compute gap will not be filled in the short term. Apple, while not building large data centers, continues to double down on edge‑AI chip development and faces chip‑supply shortages.
Energy and Hardware Demand Surge

The spending wave is having a pronounced impact on upstream supply chains. Morgan Stanley notes that AI investment heat is spreading from chip manufacturers to cloud providers and end‑use applications. Massive data‑center construction is straining GPU availability and power resources, even creating electricity competition with cryptocurrency miners.

Regarding market volatility, the world’s largest asset manager BlackRock believes recent tech‑stock sell‑offs are an "over‑reaction." BlackRock stresses that a shift in the AI competitive landscape does not signal an investment collapse; cheaper AI will instead accelerate adoption across industries, driving up overall infrastructure demand.

items.title: OpenAI殺進Token價格戰！Luna模型狂降80% AI巨頭全面拚性價比
items.title_en: OpenAI Joins Token Price War! Luna Model Slashed 80% as AI Giants Battle Cost‑Performance
paras: 人工智慧（AI）模型競爭進入價格戰新階段。OpenAI 近日宣布，大幅調降旗下兩款最新 AI 模型 GPT-5.6 Terra 與 GPT-5.6 Luna 的 API 價格，其中 Luna 降幅高達 80%，Terra 也下調 20%。值得注意的是，這項價格調整距離兩款模型正式推出僅約三週，顯示 AI 業者正加速透過成本優勢爭奪企業用戶市場。
OpenAI 於 7 月 9 日推出新一代 GPT-5.6 系列模型，包括旗艦版 Sol、主打日常工作的 Terra，以及強調高速與高性價比的 Luna。其中，Sol 版本聚焦程式設計、生物學與網路安全等高階應用能力；Terra 則鎖定企業日常工作場景；Luna 則以更低成本滿足大量使用需求。
根據 OpenAI 公布的新定價，GPT-5.6 Luna API 每百萬個輸入 Token 價格降至 0.20 美元，每百萬個輸出 Token 價格降至 1.20 美元；GPT-5.6 Terra 則調降至每百萬個輸入 Token 2 美元、輸出 Token 12 美元。
OpenAI 表示，這次調整將讓 Terra 與 Luna 模型在使用時消耗更少積分，而 Sol 版本以及 ChatGPT、Codex 訂閱價格與配額預算則維持不變。
企業控成本 AI 廠商面臨壓力
OpenAI 此次降價，背後反映企業市場對 AI 導入成本的高度敏感。隨著企業大規模部署生成式 AI，相關運算費用快速攀升，若企業無法明確看到投資回報，對高價模型的採用意願將受到影響。
業界指出，OpenAI 不僅需要滿足企業客戶對低成本 AI 工具的需求，也面臨來自 Google、微軟等科技巨頭的競爭壓力。這些競爭對手近年持續推出更具價格優勢的 AI 模型，試圖在企業市場中擴大市占。
OpenAI 表示，公司核心策略仍是同步提升模型能力與運作效率，希望每一代智慧模型都能以更低成本完成更多任務。
Token 價格戰升溫
AI 模型價格快速下滑，也代表產業競爭焦點正從單純追求模型能力，轉向「效能與成本」的綜合較量。
2022 年 ChatGPT 問世後，企業曾掀起大規模導入 AI 浪潮，甚至出現「瘋狂刷 Token（tokenmaxxing）」現象，鼓勵員工大量使用 AI 工具，而不特別考量成本。
但隨著 AI 使用量增加，企業 AI 支出快速攀升，部分公司開始重新檢視成本效益，並採取更積極的費用控管措施。
同時，開源 AI 模型崛起，也進一步改變市場競爭格局。開源模型允許企業下載、修改，並在自有基礎設施上運行，提供另一種高性價比選擇。
近期，中國 AI 新創公司月之暗面（Moonshot AI）推出開源模型 Kimi K3，在部分任務表現上已可與美國領先模型競爭，引發矽谷 AI 業者快速回應。
谷歌、Anthropic 加入競爭
在價格與效能競賽升溫之際，OpenAI 的競爭對手也紛紛推出更具成本優勢的產品。Anthropic 在 Kimi K3 發布後推出新模型 Claude Opus 5，強調其在多數應用場景中具備高效能與價格競爭力。儘管該模型在程式設計與知識工作任務上的表現接近更高階產品，但價格僅為後者的一半。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）近期也在財報電話會議中強調高性價比 AI 模型的重要性。微軟稍早推出一款主打「低成本、高效能」的網路安全模型，進一步凸顯市場對價格效率的重視。
此外，谷歌 (GOOGL-US) 本月也推出多款以成本優勢為訴求的新模型，並表示旗下 Gemini 3.6 Flash 在單次任務成本方面低於 Kimi K3。隨著主要 AI 開發商陸續調降價格，AI 市場正從「模型能力競賽」進一步邁向「Token 成本競爭」。
分析人士認為，未來 AI 產業競爭將不再只是比拼模型參數規模與推理能力，如何在維持性能的同時降低使用成本，將成為企業搶占市場的重要關鍵。
paras_en: AI model competition has entered a new phase of price wars. OpenAI recently announced a steep cut to the API pricing of its two latest AI models, GPT‑5.6 Terra and GPT‑5.6 Luna, with Luna’s price dropping by as much as 80% and Terra’s by 20%. Notably, the price adjustment comes only about three weeks after the models were officially launched, showing that AI vendors are accelerating the use of cost advantages to win over enterprise customers.

On July 9, OpenAI released the next‑generation GPT‑5.6 series, which includes the flagship Sol, the work‑day‑focused Terra, and the high‑speed, cost‑effective Luna. Sol targets advanced use cases such as programming, biology and cybersecurity; Terra is aimed at everyday enterprise tasks; and Luna is designed to meet high‑volume usage at a lower cost.

According to OpenAI’s new pricing, the GPT‑5.6 Luna API is now $0.20 per million input tokens and $1.20 per million output tokens. GPT‑5.6 Terra’s rates have been reduced to $2 per million input tokens and $12 per million output tokens.
OpenAI says the adjustment will let Terra and Luna consume fewer credits during use, while the Sol version and the subscription pricing and quotas for ChatGPT and Codex remain unchanged.

Enterprise cost‑control puts pressure on AI vendors. OpenAI’s price cuts reflect how sensitive the corporate market is to AI implementation costs. As companies roll out generative AI at scale, compute expenses are soaring, and without clear ROI, willingness to adopt high‑priced models wanes.

Industry observers note that OpenAI must satisfy enterprise demand for low‑cost AI tools while also facing competition from tech giants such as Google and Microsoft. Those rivals have been rolling out increasingly price‑competitive models in recent years, trying to expand their share of the enterprise market.
OpenAI says its core strategy remains to improve model capability and operational efficiency in tandem, hoping each new intelligent model can accomplish more tasks at lower cost.
The token‑price war heats up. Rapid declines in AI model pricing indicate that competition is shifting from pure performance to a combined focus on efficiency and cost.

After ChatGPT’s 2022 debut, companies launched massive AI adoption waves, even encouraging “token‑maxxing” – heavy use of AI tools without regard to cost. As usage grew, corporate AI spend surged, prompting many firms to re‑evaluate cost‑effectiveness and adopt stricter expense controls.

At the same time, the rise of open‑source AI models is reshaping the competitive landscape. Open‑source models let companies download, modify, and run them on their own infrastructure, offering another high‑value‑for‑money option.

Recently, Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI released the open‑source model Kimi K3, which on some tasks can already compete with leading U.S. models, prompting a swift response from Silicon Valley AI players.

Google and Anthropic join the competition. As price and performance battles intensify, rivals are launching more cost‑effective products. After Kimi K3’s release, Anthropic introduced Claude Opus 5, touting high performance and price competitiveness across most use cases. Although its performance on programming and knowledge‑work tasks approaches higher‑tier products, its price is only half as much.

Microsoft (MSFT‑US) CEO Satya Nadella recently emphasized the importance of high‑value‑for‑money AI models during an earnings call. Microsoft earlier unveiled a “low‑cost, high‑performance” cybersecurity model, underscoring market focus on price efficiency.

Google (GOOGL‑US) also rolled out several new models this month that stress cost advantage, claiming its Gemini 3.6 Flash costs less per task than Kimi K3. As major AI developers keep lowering prices, the market is moving from a “model capability race” toward a “token‑cost competition.”

Analysts believe future AI industry competition will no longer be just about model size and inference power; the ability to lower usage costs while maintaining performance will become a key factor for companies vying for market share.

items.title: AI需求噴發推升獲利 鎧俠當季淨利暴增45倍
items.title_en: AI Demand Surge Boosts Profits, Armored Knight’s Quarterly Net Profit Surges 45‑Fold
paras: 日本半導體大廠鎧俠控股周五 (31 日) 公布 2026 會計年度第一季 (4 月至 6 月) 財務報告。受惠於全球 AI 資料中心 對記憶體零件的強勁需求，公司單季淨利較去年同期大幅成長超過 45 倍，顯示人工智慧浪潮正持續帶動快閃記憶體市場的回溫。

財務表現：獲利能力創歷史新高

根據財報數據，鎧俠該季淨利由去年同期的 183 億日元大幅躍升至 8,422 億日元。單季營收則來到 1.77 兆日元，較去年同期成長約 4 至 5 倍。在獲利指標方面，營業利益達到 1.27 兆日元 (Non-GAAP 基準為 1.33 兆日元)，年增率高達約 2,700%。
鎧俠指出，業績成長主要歸因於 NAND 快閃記憶體價格的上漲以及出貨量的增加。特別是在企業級固態硬碟 (Enterprise SSD) 領域，由於 AI 伺服器需求持續釋放，帶動此類產品單季營收創下歷史紀錄。儘管獲利數據驚人，但營收仍略低於部分市場分析師預期的 1.84 兆日元。

市場驅動力與產品技術進展

全球技術龍頭對 AI 基礎設施的投資熱潮，已將記憶體零件推向高價。鎧俠的核心產品 NAND 快閃記憶體因 AI 代理工具需要龐大存儲空間而成為熱門商品。
公司觀察到，全球 NAND 市場目前處於 供需緊繃 狀態，一方面是 AI 訓練對高容量硬碟的需求成長，另一方面則是各大記憶體廠在過去兩年嚴格控管資本支出，導致新產能釋放有限。
在技術研發上，鎧俠已開始交付第九代與第十代 BiCS FLASH 快閃記憶體晶片樣本，預計將應用於智慧型手機、個人電腦及伺服器。該公司表示，新款伺服器固態硬碟的讀取速度是早期版本的 8 倍以上，顯見在 AI 領域的技術布局。

未來展望與戰略布局

針對第二季 (7 月至 9 月) 的營運展望，鎧俠預估營收將進一步增至 2.39 兆日元，營業利益可望達到 1.89 兆至 1.9 兆日元。儘管此獲利指引略低於彭博社調查分析師預期的 1.95 兆日元，但公司預期 NAND 平均售價將持續上漲，支撐業績表現。
為了提升股東價值與資本效率，鎧俠宣布了一系列戰略舉措，包括：

股票分割：將於 2026 年 10 月 1 日執行 1 拆 3 的拆股計畫。
股份回購：計畫於 8 月至 10 月間回購最高達 8,000 億日元的庫藏股。
上市計畫：公司正研議於美國上市。


市場意見與股東結構變化

主要股東貝恩資本 (Bain Capital) 日本代表 Yuji Sugimoto 對公司前景表示樂觀，他認為：「雖然業務在短期內具有周期性，但從中長期來看，鎧俠的企業價值成長速度將超過 GDP 成長速度。」
目前東芝 (Toshiba) 已取代貝恩資本成為最大股東，持股約 15%。而南韓晶片大廠 SK 海力士則透過特殊目的公司間接持有約 14% 股份，其競爭與合作關係亦受到市場密切關注。
投資機構如野村證券 (Nomura) 則維持對鎧俠的「買進」評等，認為 AI 驅動的企業級儲存需求仍處於快速成長階段，NAND 價格上漲的力道可能持續超出市場預期。
paras_en: Japan’s major semiconductor firm Armored Knight Holdings announced its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2026 (April‑June) on Friday the 31st. Benefiting from strong global AI data‑center demand for memory components, the company’s quarterly net profit grew more than 45 times year‑over‑year, showing that the AI wave continues to warm the flash memory market.
Financial performance: Profitability hits a historic high

According to the report, Armored Knight’s net profit for the quarter jumped from ¥18.3 billion in the same period last year to ¥842.2 billion. Quarterly revenue reached ¥1.77 trillion, about four to five times the prior‑year level. Operating profit was ¥1.27 trillion (Non‑GAAP ¥1.33 trillion), a year‑over‑year increase of roughly 2,700%.

Armored Knight said the growth was mainly driven by higher NAND flash prices and increased shipments. In particular, the enterprise SSD segment set a record quarterly revenue as AI server demand kept expanding. Although the profit figures were spectacular, revenue was slightly below some analysts’ expectations of ¥1.84 trillion.
Market drivers and product technology advances

The global tech leaders’ rush to invest in AI infrastructure has pushed memory component prices higher. Armored Knight’s core product, NAND flash memory, has become a hot item because AI workloads require massive storage capacity.

The company observes that the worldwide NAND market is currently in a tight supply‑demand situation: on one hand, AI training drives up demand for high‑capacity drives; on the other, major memory makers have tightly controlled capex over the past two years, limiting new capacity releases.

In R&D, Armored Knight has begun shipping samples of its 9th‑ and 10th‑generation BiCS FLASH chips, expected to be used in smartphones, PCs and servers. The firm says the new server SSDs read more than eight times faster than earlier versions, underscoring its technical positioning in the AI arena.
Future outlook and strategic positioning

For the second quarter (July‑September), Armored Knight forecasts revenue of about ¥2.39 trillion and operating profit of ¥1.89‑¥1.90 trillion. While this profit guidance is a bit below Bloomberg analysts’ estimate of ¥1.95 trillion, the company expects average NAND selling prices to keep rising, supporting performance.

To enhance shareholder value and capital efficiency, Armored Knight announced several strategic measures: a 1‑for‑3 stock split to be executed on October 1 2026; a share‑buyback program of up to ¥800 billion planned for August‑October; and plans under consideration for a U.S. listing.
Market opinion and shareholder structure changes

Bain Capital’s Japan representative Yuji Sugimoto expressed optimism about the company’s prospects, noting that although the business is cyclically volatile in the short term, its mid‑to‑long‑term enterprise value growth should outpace GDP growth. Toshiba has now overtaken Bain Capital as the largest shareholder with roughly 15% ownership, while South Korea’s SK Hynix holds about 14% indirectly through a special purpose vehicle, drawing market attention to their competitive and cooperative dynamics. Nomura maintains a “Buy” rating on Armored Knight, arguing that AI‑driven enterprise storage demand remains in a rapid growth phase and that NAND price gains may continue to exceed market expectations.

items.title: AI需求持續強勁 台灣第二季GDP年增12.92%優於市場預期
items.title_en: AI Demand Remains Strong, Taiwan Q2 GDP Grows 12.92% YoY, Beating Market Expectations
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 主計處31日公布初步統計，2026年第二季國內生產毛額（GDP）年增率12.92%，優於分析師預估的10.8%。主計處表示，全球人工智慧（AI）需求持續強勁，加上台美貿易與投資關係持續深化，帶動出口、投資及生產活動成長，推升第二季經濟表現。
雖然第二季GDP增速較第一季的14.55%略為放緩，但仍維持雙位數成長，表現優於市場預期。
主計處指出，第二季商品與服務實質出口年增率21.64%，主要受AI相關需求持續熱絡帶動；實質進口年增率18.27%，反映企業持續擴充產能、增加資本設備投資，支撐整體經濟成長動能。
近年來，台灣持續降低對中國市場的依賴，並受惠於美國推動供應鏈重組。過去25年來，美國自台灣進口商品金額首次高於自中國進口，美國也成為台灣對外投資最大目的地。今年前五個月，台灣對中國投資占整體對外投資比重已不到1%，反映台美經貿合作持續深化。
台灣在全球AI供應鏈中占有關鍵地位，全球最大晶圓代工廠台積電(2330-TW)受惠AI晶片需求快速成長，帶動半導體出口、企業投資及高科技供應鏈持續擴張，成為支撐台灣經濟成長的重要動能。
官方統計顯示，2026年6月台灣出口金額年增率40.3%，達748.3億美元，顯示AI伺服器、半導體及相關電子產品需求依然強勁。
不過，未來挑戰在於如何將AI帶來的經濟成長效益擴散至服務業及傳統產業，透過提升薪資、擴大投資及推動產業升級，讓更多中小企業及勞工共享經濟成長成果。

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (Yoo Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics released preliminary figures on the 31st showing that Taiwan’s gross domestic product (GDP) grew 12.92% year‑on‑year in the second quarter of 2026, ahead of analysts’ forecast of 10.8%. The agency said that global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) remains robust, and deepening Taiwan‑U.S. trade and investment ties have boosted exports, investment and production activities, lifting the economy in Q2.
Although Q2 GDP growth slowed slightly from the 14.55% pace in Q1, it still posted double‑digit growth and outperformed market expectations.

The statistics office noted that real exports of goods and services rose 21.64% year‑on‑year in Q2, driven mainly by sustained hot demand for AI‑related products; real imports grew 18.27% year‑on‑year, reflecting firms’ continued capacity expansion and capital equipment investment, supporting overall economic momentum.

In recent years Taiwan has been steadily reducing its reliance on the Chinese market and has benefited from the United States’ push to restructure supply chains. For the first time in 25 years, the value of U.S. imports from Taiwan has surpassed those from China, and the United States has become Taiwan’s largest destination for overseas investment. In the first five months of this year, Taiwan’s investment in China accounted for less than 1% of total overseas investment, indicating deepening Taiwan‑U.S. economic cooperation.

Taiwan occupies a key position in the global AI supply chain, and the world’s largest wafer foundry, TSMC (2330‑TW), is benefiting from rapid growth in AI chip demand, driving semiconductor exports, corporate investment and the expansion of the high‑tech supply chain, becoming a major engine of Taiwan’s economic growth.

Official statistics show that Taiwan’s export value rose 40.3% year‑on‑year in June 2026, reaching $74.83 billion, underscoring continued strong demand for AI servers, semiconductors and related electronic products.

However, the future challenge lies in spreading the economic benefits generated by AI to the services sector and traditional industries, by raising wages, expanding investment and promoting industrial upgrading so that more SMEs and workers can share the gains of economic growth.

items.title: 砸41.5億強攻企業AI！繼微軟後OpenAI成立FDE「特種部隊」攜手BCG、貝恩構築頂級顧問網絡
items.title_en: Spending $4.15 Billion to Attack Enterprise AI! After Microsoft, OpenAI Launches FDE “Special Forces” and Teams Up with BCG, Bain to Build a Top‑Tier Consulting Network
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，在消費級 AI 應用趨於飽和之際，OpenAI 正以前所未有的力道轉向企業級市場，試圖填補尖端模型能力與企業實際應用之間的巨大鴻溝。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ)周五 (31 日) 報導，OpenAI 近期連出兩記重拳：成立獨立服務子公司「OpenAI Deployment Co.」(簡稱 DeployCo)，並斥資 1.5 億美元構建頂級諮詢夥伴網絡，雙管齊下搶占數千億美元的企業 AI 服務市場。
DeployCo 在 5 月正式掛牌，由 TPG 領投 40 億美元，Advent、貝恩資本、Brookfield 等巨頭聯合參投。該公司脫胎於 OpenAI 對 AI 諮詢公司 Tomoro 及應用開發商 Northslope 的連續收購，目前已集結數百名「前線部署工程師」(FDE)。這支被視為「特種部隊」的隊伍，將直接進駐企業客戶現場，將抽象的模型能力轉化為具體的業務流程。
DeployCo 技術長 Arnaud Fournier 說：「模型能力與人們實際使用之間的差距，從未像現在這樣巨大。」
以西班牙對外銀行 (BBVA) 為例，一名 FDE 協助該行重構信貸風險分析工具，引入 AI 智能體互評機制，使工具準確率從不足 60% 躍升至 80%。
OpenAI 內部 FDE 負責人 Colin Jarvis 指出，FDE 團隊通常嵌入客戶數月至數年，規模從一人到五人不等，涵蓋從概念驗證到全面部署的全週期。
然而，技術落地僅是難題的一半。顧能 (Gartner) 分析師 Arun Chandrasekaran 指出，AI 實驗室缺乏與董事會及「長字輩」高管對話的管道，難以推動深層次的組織變革。
因此，OpenAI 同步推出 1.5 億美元的合作夥伴計劃，將波士頓諮詢 (BCG)、貝恩、埃森哲等頂級諮詢巨頭納入生態系。
BCG 全球合作與聯盟負責人 Vikas Taneja 強調，諮詢公司的核心價值在於協助企業應對「變革管理」，像是如何調整組織架構、重塑工作流程、管理員工預期，以承接 AI 帶來的效率飛躍。
OpenAI 全球合作與生態副總裁 Colleen Kapase 說：「將先進模型轉化為真實業務價值，需要一個值得信賴的夥伴生態系統。」
TPG 合夥人 Peter McGoohan 預測，企業 AI 服務的可尋址市場規模最終將達數千億美元。
這場競賽已趨於白熱化。Anthropic 在 3 月推出類似的「應用 AI 團隊」及夥伴計畫，微軟與亞馬遜也相繼佈局 FDE 服務。
對於剛完成新一輪融資、亟需證明商業化能力的 OpenAI 而言，DeployCo 及其夥伴網絡不僅是技術落地的抓手，更是支撐其天價估值、對抗競爭對手的戰略護城河。企業 AI 的「最後一哩路」正成為巨頭們角力的新戰場。
paras_en: Foreign media reports note that as consumer‑grade AI applications approach saturation, OpenAI is shifting to the enterprise market with unprecedented force, aiming to bridge the huge gap between cutting‑edge model capabilities and real‑world business use.

The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday (the 31st) that OpenAI has dealt two heavy blows recently: it created an independent services subsidiary called OpenAI Deployment Co. (shortened to DeployCo) and is spending $150 million to build a top‑tier consulting partner network, a two‑pronged effort to capture the multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar enterprise AI services market.

DeployCo was officially launched in May, backed by a $4 billion lead investment from TPG, with Advent, Bain Capital, Brookfield and other giants co‑investing. The company emerged from OpenAI’s successive acquisitions of AI consulting firm Tomoro and application developer Northslope, and now has assembled hundreds of “Front‑line Deployment Engineers” (FDE). This team, described as a “special forces” unit, will go on‑site at corporate customers to turn abstract model capabilities into concrete business processes.
DeployCo’s chief technology officer Arnaud Fournier said, “The gap between model capabilities and what people actually use has never been this large.”

Taking Spain’s Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA) as an example, an FDE helped the bank revamp its credit‑risk analysis tool, introducing an AI‑agent peer‑review mechanism that lifted the tool’s accuracy from under 60 % to 80 %.

OpenAI’s internal FDE head Colin Jarvis noted that FDE teams typically embed with clients for months to years, ranging in size from one to five people, covering the full cycle from proof‑of‑concept to full deployment.

However, technology deployment is only half the challenge. Gartner analyst Arun Chandrasekaran pointed out that AI labs often lack channels to communicate with boards and senior‑level executives, making deep organizational change difficult to drive.
Therefore, OpenAI is simultaneously launching a $150 million partner program, bringing top consulting giants such as Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Bain, and Accenture into its ecosystem.

BCG’s global head of partnerships and alliances Vikas Taneja emphasized that a consulting firm’s core value lies in helping companies manage “change management”—adjusting organizational structures, redesigning workflows, and managing employee expectations to capture AI‑driven efficiency gains.
OpenAI’s vice‑president of global partnerships and ecosystem Colleen Kapase said, “Turning advanced models into real business value requires a trustworthy partner ecosystem.”
TPG partner Peter McGoohan predicts that the addressable market for enterprise AI services will ultimately reach several hundred billion dollars.
The race has heated up. Anthropic launched a similar “Application AI Team” and partner program in March, and Microsoft and Amazon have also rolled out FDE services.

For OpenAI, which has just completed a new financing round and is eager to prove its commercialization chops, DeployCo and its partner network are not only a means to implement technology but also a strategic moat supporting its sky‑high valuation and defending against rivals. The “last mile” of enterprise AI is becoming the new battlefield for the giants.

items.title: 慧榮與聯發科下周主題演講 聚焦新一代AI車用平台
items.title_en: Simo and MediaTek to Deliver Joint Keynote Next Week Focusing on Next‑Generation AI‑Ready Automotive Platform
paras: 慧榮科技 (SIMO-US) 今 (31) 日宣布，將與聯發科 (2454-TW) 於 FMS 2026 主題演講中，聚焦新一代 AI-Ready 車用平台。此次主題演講將結合聯發科最新車載座艙平台與慧榮先進的車用儲存技術，說明高效能、高可靠性的儲存解決方案如何滿足新一代智慧汽車日益成長的資料處理需求。
本場演講將於 8 月 4 日下午 2:20 在美國舉行，由慧榮 Edge SSD 產品事業部協理副總黃士德、聯發科車用系統架構總監 Waheed Ahmed，以及慧榮科技企業級產品行銷資深協理 Shamil Sharief 共同主講，分享智慧儲存技術如何支援新一代 AI 車用平台、代理式 AI 與 AI 基礎設施的發展，並探討智慧儲存架構在未來 AI 應用中的關鍵角色。
慧榮指出，隨著車用產業邁入實體 AI 時代，智慧車輛已成為最具代表性的邊緣 AI 應用之一，所產生與處理的資料量正以前所未有的速度成長。憑藉超過十年的車用市場深耕，公司已成為車用產業值得信賴的儲存技術合作夥伴，持續提供兼具高效能、低功耗、高安全性與高可靠性的儲存解決方案，滿足新一代 AI 定義汽車 (AI-defined Vehicles) 的需求。
慧榮正透過與全球領先汽車 OEM、Tier 1 供應商、SoC 合作夥伴及 NAND Flash 大廠的緊密合作，公司儲存技術已廣泛應用於全球 AI 智慧座艙與車載運算平台。
慧榮科技邊緣 SSD 產品事業部協理副總黃士德表示，隨著 AI 工作負載日益趨向資料密集化，儲存架構已成為智慧系統效能的核心基礎，從 AI 定義汽車到 AI 工廠皆是如此。透過與聯發科的合作，將分享先進儲存架構如何提供智慧化資料管理、可預測的效能表現，以及新一代 AI 定義汽車所需的高可靠性。
聯發科車用系統架構總監 Waheed Ahmed 表示，AI 正加速將汽車轉型為智慧運算平台，也對高效能、高可靠性的資料基礎架構提出全新要求。我們與慧榮科技的合作，充分展現先進運算與智慧儲存如何相輔相成，共同推動 AI-Ready 車輛的未來發展。
paras_en: Simo Technology (SIMO-US) announced today (31st) that it will join MediaTek (2454‑TW) for a keynote at FMS 2026, focusing on the next‑generation AI‑Ready automotive platform. The presentation will combine MediaTek’s latest in‑vehicle cockpit platform with Simo’s advanced automotive storage technology, illustrating how high‑performance, highly reliable storage solutions can meet the growing data‑processing demands of next‑generation smart cars.

The talk will be held on August 4 at 2:20 PM in the United States and will be co‑presented by Simo’s Deputy General Manager of the Edge SSD Business Unit, Huang Shide; MediaTek Automotive Systems Architecture Director Waheed Ahmed; and Simo’s Senior Associate Director of Enterprise Product Marketing, Shamil Sharief. They will discuss how intelligent storage technology supports next‑generation AI automotive platforms, agent‑based AI, and AI infrastructure development, and explore the critical role of smart storage architecture in future AI applications.

Simo notes that as the automotive industry enters the physical AI era, smart vehicles have become one of the most representative edge‑AI applications, with data generation and processing accelerating at unprecedented rates. With more than a decade of deep involvement in the automotive market, the company has become a trusted storage‑technology partner for the industry, continuously delivering solutions that combine high performance, low power, high security and high reliability to meet the needs of AI‑defined Vehicles.

Through close collaboration with global automotive OEMs, Tier‑1 suppliers, SoC partners and major NAND‑Flash manufacturers, Simo’s storage technology is now widely deployed in AI‑enabled cockpits and in‑vehicle compute platforms worldwide.

Simo’s Deputy General Manager of the Edge SSD Business Unit, Huang Shide, said that as AI workloads become increasingly data‑intensive, storage architecture has become the core foundation of smart‑system performance—from AI‑defined cars to AI factories. By partnering with MediaTek, they will share how advanced storage architectures provide intelligent data management, predictable performance, and the high reliability required by next‑generation AI‑defined vehicles.

MediaTek Automotive Systems Architecture Director Waheed Ahmed stated that AI is accelerating the transformation of cars into smart computing platforms, creating new demands for high‑performance, highly reliable data infrastructure. The collaboration with Simo demonstrates how advanced compute and intelligent storage complement each other to drive the future of AI‑Ready vehicles.

items.title: 日本郵船斥資1,200億日圓收購NS United Kaiun 強化散裝航運布局
items.title_en: Nippon Yusen to Spend ¥120 billion on Acquisition of NS United Kaiun, Bolstering Bulk Shipping Portfolio
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本郵船Nippon Yusen Kaiun於7月31日宣布，將對散裝航運公司NS United Kaiun(9110-JP)發動公開收購（Tender Offer，TOB），預計投入約1,200億日圓，並配合NS United Kaiun同步實施的庫藏股收購計畫，最終將持股提高至83.33%，使NS United Kaiun成為旗下子公司。
根據收購方案，日本郵船將以每股10,600日圓收購NS United Kaiun股票，較7月31日收盤價8,040日圓溢價約32%。公開收購預計於2026年11月底至12月底之間展開，計畫收購11,379,482股，占已發行股數48.29%，最低收購門檻為14.96%。
目前，日本郵船已持有NS United Kaiun 18.35%股權，雙方原本屬於權益法投資關係。完成此次公開收購後，日本郵船將大幅提高持股比重，進一步強化對公司的經營控制。
日本郵船是全球最大的綜合航運企業之一，截至2024年3月管理824艘船舶，總載重噸位達6,970萬噸（DWT），船隊涵蓋貨櫃船、汽車運輸船、散裝貨輪、油輪、LNG運輸船等多元船型，在全球45個國家設有650個物流中心，業務遍及亞洲、歐洲及北美。

近年日本郵船正推動中期經營計畫「Sail Green, Drive Transformations 2026」，規劃四年投入1.4兆日圓，聚焦能源轉型、數位轉型及高附加價值物流三大方向，包括擴充LNG運輸船隊、布局離岸風電支援船舶、發展下一代能源運輸，以及透過AI與雲端技術提升營運效率。同時，公司也積極透過併購擴大物流版圖，包括收購醫藥物流業務，並逐步退出需求持續萎縮的木片運輸業務，持續優化事業組合。

paras_en: On July 31, 2026, Nippon Yusen Kaiun (NYK) announced that it will launch a public tender offer for bulk‑shipping company NS United Kaiun (ticker 9110‑JP). Initiatives include expanding its LNG carrier fleet, deploying vessels to support offshore wind farms, developing next‑generation energy transport solutions, and leveraging AI and cloud technologies to boost operational efficiency. items.title: 銅價定價邏輯變了！中國需求影響力退場美元與AI長期需求接棒
items.title_en: Copper Pricing Logic Has Changed! China Demand Influence Fades, Dollar and AI Long‑Term Demand Take Over
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 際銅價周五走高，倫敦金屬交易所（LME）3個月期銅7月累計可望上漲約3.5%。近期銅價主要受到美元走弱，以及聯準會維持利率不變後，市場投資氣氛轉佳的帶動。
7月上旬，銅價因中國需求穩定、庫存下降及市場擔心供應吃緊而走高。但近期這些支撐因素開始減弱。反映中國現貨需求的洋山銅溢價不再上升，LME倉庫提貨需求減少，上海期貨交易所監測的銅庫存本周也僅減少276公噸，顯示需求並沒有明顯增強。
在中國尚未推出新的刺激政策，加上本周公布的PMI數據不如市場預期後，銅價近期已不再主要跟著中國需求變化，而是更容易受到美元漲跌和全球股市表現影響。換句話說，銅價的定價邏輯改變。

銅價上漲並非短期供需驅動
雖然2026年全球銅價屢創歷史新高，但背後並非供不應求，而是在供給仍高於需求的情況下，由政策預期與長期需求題材推動價格上漲。
2026年前五個月，全球精煉銅產量同比增長約3%至1,205萬噸，而消費量僅增長2.2%至1,158萬噸，整體市場仍處於供給大於需求的狀態。
不過，市場看好未來需求，因此持續推升銅價，主要有三大原因。
首先，美國計劃對進口精煉銅加徵關稅。美國商務部於2026年6月底建議，自2027年起分階段調高精煉銅進口關稅，由15%提高至2028年的30%。在政策正式實施前，市場提前備貨，吸引大量銅流向美國，也使其他地區供應相對吃緊。
其次，AI帶動的資料中心建設持續增加銅需求。隨著科技業大舉投資AI基礎設施，電力電纜、變壓器及冷卻設備都需要大量用銅。市場普遍認為，目前的供給過剩只是短期現象，未來AI相關投資將使需求增速超過供給。
第三，供應端仍存在不少限制。中國持續打擊廢銅產業的增值稅違規行為，導致廢銅供應減少，部分冶煉廠因此停產，並提高對進口銅的需求。同時，印尼Grasberg銅礦擴產進度低於預期，預估要到2027年底才能全面達產，2026年下半年的產能利用率也由原先預估的85%下修至65%，使市場對未來供應仍有疑慮。
根據UBS估計，目前資料中心及相關發電設施約占全球銅需求的3%，到了2030年前後將提高至約4%，並可望貢獻2025年至2030年間全球銅需求新增量的15%至20%，顯示AI仍是未來銅需求最重要的成長動能之一。

paras_en: On July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Copper prices rose on Friday, with the London Metal Exchange (LME) three‑month copper contract expected to gain about 3.5% for July. Recent price moves have been driven mainly by a weaker dollar and improved market sentiment after the Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged.

In early July, copper rose on the back of stable Chinese demand, falling inventories and market worries about tightening supply. Those support factors have since weakened. The Yangshan copper premium, which reflects Chinese spot demand, stopped rising, LME warehouse draw‑downs fell, and the Shanghai Futures Exchange reported copper stocks fell by only 276 tonnes this week, indicating demand has not noticeably strengthened.

With China yet to roll out new stimulus measures and this week’s PMI data coming in below expectations, copper is no longer moving primarily with Chinese demand. Instead, it is more sensitive to dollar fluctuations and global equity market performance – in other words, the pricing logic for copper has shifted.

Copper’s recent rise is not a short‑term supply‑demand swing. Although global copper prices have hit record highs in 2026, the rally is not because supply is insufficient; rather, it is being pushed by policy expectations and long‑term demand themes while supply still exceeds demand.

In the first five months of 2026, global refined copper output grew about 3% year‑on‑year to 12.05 million tonnes, while consumption rose only 2.2% to 11.58 million tonnes, leaving the market overall in a surplus condition.

Nevertheless, the market remains optimistic about future demand, keeping price pressure on copper for three main reasons. First, the United States plans to raise tariffs on imported refined copper. The U.S. Department of Commerce suggested at the end of June 2026 that, starting in 2027, tariffs on refined copper imports be phased up from 15% to 30% by 2028. Anticipating the policy, buyers have begun stockpiling, pulling large volumes of copper into the United States and tightening supplies elsewhere.

Second, AI‑driven data‑center construction continues to boost copper demand. As the tech sector pours money into AI infrastructure, power cables, transformers and cooling equipment—all heavy copper users—are in higher demand. The market broadly believes that the current oversupply is a short‑term blip and that AI‑related investment will push demand growth ahead of supply.

Third, supply constraints persist. China’s crackdown on VAT violations in the scrap‑copper sector has cut scrap supply, forcing some smelters to shut down and increasing reliance on imported copper. At the same time, Indonesia’s Grasberg copper mine expansion is lagging, with full production not expected until the end of 2027; the plant’s capacity utilisation for the second half of 2026 has been revised down from an assumed 85% to 65%, keeping supply‑side worries alive.

UBS estimates that data‑centers and related power facilities currently account for about 3% of global copper demand and could rise to roughly 4% around 2030, potentially contributing 15%‑20% of the incremental copper demand between 2025 and 2030. This underscores AI as one of the key growth drivers for copper demand in the years ahead.

items.title_en: Sony Raises Full-Year Outlook as Q1 Net Profit Beats Expectations, Up 32% YoY; Entertainment and Image Sensor Businesses Drive Growth
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本電子與娛樂大廠Sony Group宣布，受惠於音樂與影像感測器業務獲利成長，截至2026年6月底止的2026財年第一季淨利表現優於市場預期，並同步上修全年財測。
Sony表示，截至2026年6月底止的2026財年第一季，日本電子與娛樂大廠Sony Group受惠於音樂與影像感測器業務獲利成長，淨利表現優於市場預期，並同步上修全年財測。
截至2026年6月底止的三個月，Sony淨利年增率32%，達3,422億日圓（約21.5億美元），高於Visible Alpha調查分析師平均預估的2,626億日圓。
第一季營收年增率8.2%，達2.84兆日圓。受惠於遊戲、音樂、電影及影像感測器業務獲利提升，公司營業利益同步成長。
Sony並上調截至2027年3月止的2026財年（Fiscal Year）全年財測，預估營收將年增率0.2%，至12.5兆日圓，高於先前預估的12.3兆日圓；全年淨利預估將年增率17%，達1.21兆日圓，也高於原先預估的1.16兆日圓。
公司表示，全年獲利成長主要仍將由娛樂內容及影像感測器業務支撐。
近年來，Sony持續投入數十億美元進行併購，擴大娛樂內容版圖，同時逐步淡出部分非核心業務，以調整事業布局。
今年3月，Sony斥資約460百萬美元，將持有《Peanuts》角色（包括Snoopy與Charlie Brown）相關公司的持股比例提高至80%，約為原來的兩倍。此外，公司已於2025年10月分拆金融業務。
Sony今年5月宣布，將與台積電(2330-TW)成立合資公司，共同開發與生產新一代影像感測器。公司希望藉由合資模式降低資本支出，並因應人工智慧時代機器視覺需求快速成長所帶動的影像感測器市場需求。
此外，Sony於美國東岸時間2026年7月30日表示，已提出收購日本相機鏡頭製造商Tamron(7740-JP)的提案，以進一步強化相機業務布局。截至2025年底，Sony已持有Tamron約15%的股權，為該公司主要股東之一。

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis / Industry Data Center report) – Japan’s electronics and entertainment giant Sony Group announced that, boosted by profit growth in its music and image‑sensor businesses, its net profit for the first quarter of fiscal 2026 (ended June 30, 2026) exceeded market expectations, and the company simultaneously raised its full‑year financial guidance.

Sony said that, thanks to profit growth in its music and image‑sensor businesses, net profit for the first quarter of fiscal 2026, which ended on June 30, 2026, outperformed market expectations, prompting an upward revision of its full‑year outlook.
For the three months ended June 30, 2026, Sony’s net profit rose 32% year‑over‑year to ¥342.2 billion (about $2.15 billion), above the Visible Alpha analysts’ average forecast of ¥262.6 billion.
First‑quarter revenue grew 8.2% year‑over‑year to ¥2.84 trillion. Higher earnings from gaming, music, movies and image‑sensor businesses also lifted operating profit.

Sony also lifted its full‑year forecast for fiscal 2026 (ending March 2027). Revenue is now expected to grow 0.2% year‑over‑year to ¥12.5 trillion, up from the prior estimate of ¥12.3 trillion; full‑year net profit is projected to rise 17% year‑over‑year to ¥1.21 trillion, higher than the earlier estimate of ¥1.16 trillion.
The company said that profit growth for the year will continue to be driven primarily by its entertainment‑content and image‑sensor businesses.

In recent years, Sony has continued to invest tens of billions of dollars in acquisitions to expand its entertainment‑content footprint, while gradually exiting some non‑core businesses to reshape its portfolio.

In March this year, Sony spent roughly $460 million to increase its stake in the company that owns the "Peanuts" characters (including Snoopy and Charlie Brown) to 80%, about double its previous holding. The firm also spun off its financial services business in October 2025.

In May, Sony announced a joint venture with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC, 2330‑TW) to co‑develop and produce next‑generation image sensors. The partnership is intended to lower capital expenditures and meet the rapidly growing demand for machine‑vision sensors in the AI era.

Additionally, on July 30, 2026 (U.S. Eastern Time), Sony said it had submitted a proposal to acquire Japanese camera‑lens maker Tamron (7740‑JP) to further strengthen its camera business. As of the end of 2025, Sony already owned about 15% of Tamron, making it one of the company’s largest shareholders.

items.title: 中國需求疲弱、中東局勢衝擊 豐田Toyota上半年全球銷量年減2.8%仍居全球第一
items.title_en: Weak Chinese Demand and Middle East Tensions Hit Toyota; H1 Global Sales Down 2.8% Yet Still World Leader
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本汽車大廠豐田Toyota(TM-US)公布，2026年上半年（1至6月）全球共賣出539萬輛汽車，較去年同期減少2.8%，是近兩年來首度出現銷售下滑。不過，豐田仍穩坐全球汽車銷售冠軍，銷量高於德國福斯集團Volkswagen Group(VOWG_p-DE)的413萬輛。
豐田表示，上半年銷售下滑，主要受到中國市場需求疲弱，以及中東局勢緊張推升油價，影響消費者購車意願。
除了銷售下滑，豐田上半年全球產量也小幅減少0.3%，降至551萬輛。公司指出，中東局勢造成物流運輸受阻，也影響出口表現，日本出口至中東的車輛較去年同期大減36%，降至10萬4,093輛。
從市場來看，海外市場仍是豐田最主要的收入來源，但上半年海外銷量年減率4.5%，降至430萬輛；反觀日本國內市場，在新款bZ4X純電動車帶動下，銷量年增率4.4%，達110萬輛。
各地區表現差異明顯。其中，中國市場因需求持續低迷，銷量年減率17.1%，降至69萬4,670輛，是衰退最明顯的市場；中東市場也因地緣政治衝突影響，銷量年減率21.6%，降至21萬8,855輛。
相較之下，北美市場仍維持穩健成長。受惠於油電混合車需求持續增加，豐田上半年在北美賣出145萬輛汽車，年增率0.9%，成為支撐整體銷售的重要市場。
整體來看，雖然中國需求疲弱及中東物流受阻拖累業績，但豐田憑藉油電混合車的競爭力，以及在全球市場的多元布局，仍成功守住全球汽車銷售龍頭地位。

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Japanese automaker Toyota (TM‑US) reported that it sold 5.39 million vehicles worldwide in the first half of 2026 (January‑June), a 2.8% decline from the same period last year, marking the first sales drop in two years. Nevertheless, Toyota remains the global sales champion, outpacing Germany’s Volkswagen Group (VOWG_p‑DE), which sold 4.13 million units.
Toyota said the sales dip was mainly caused by weak demand in the Chinese market and higher oil prices driven by tensions in the Middle East, which dampened consumers’ willingness to buy cars.

In addition to the sales decline, Toyota’s global production in the first half fell slightly by 0.3% to 5.51 million units. The company noted that Middle‑East turmoil disrupted logistics and hurt export performance, with Japanese vehicle exports to the region plunging 36% year‑on‑year to 104,093 units.

From a market perspective, overseas sales remain Toyota’s primary revenue source, but overseas volumes fell 4.5% year‑on‑year to 4.30 million units in the first half. By contrast, the domestic Japanese market saw a 4.4% year‑on‑year increase, reaching 1.10 million units, driven by the new bZ4X pure‑electric model.

Regional performance varied sharply. China, plagued by persistently low demand, saw sales tumble 17.1% year‑on‑year to 694,670 units, making it the most pronounced decline. The Middle East also suffered, with sales down 21.6% year‑on‑year to 218,855 units due to geopolitical conflict.

In contrast, the North American market continued steady growth. Benefiting from rising demand for hybrid vehicles, Toyota sold 1.45 million cars in North America in the first half, a 0.9% year‑on‑year increase, making it a key pillar supporting overall sales.

Overall, despite the drag from weak Chinese demand and Middle‑East logistics disruptions, Toyota’s competitive hybrid lineup and diversified global footprint allowed it to retain its position as the world’s top automaker.

items.title: 日本央行維持利率不變 下修通膨預期但保留後續升息空間
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged, Lowers Inflation Forecast but Leaves Room for Future Rate Hikes
paras: 日本央行在周五 (31 日) 的金融政策決定會議上，以 8 比 1 的壓倒性多數票數決定將政策利率維持在 1.0% 不變 ，此舉反映出日銀在 6 月升息後，傾向於觀察其對經濟與物價情勢的影響，並對中東衝突與日元匯率保持謹慎態度。
受周五決定的影響，日元走弱，美元兌日元匯率上漲 0.7%。
在本次會議中，審議委員高田創是唯一的反對者。他提議將利率提高至 1.25% 左右，認為隨著海外金融政策轉向及國內物價上行風險增加，日本已進入需要機動調整政策的「新階段」，但此案最終被多數否決。
根據日銀同步發布的「經濟與物價情勢展望報告」，政策委員將 2026 年度實質國內總生產 (GDP) 人工智慧 (AI) 相關需求的增加，以及政府補助政策對國內消費的支撐。
在物價方面，2026 年度的核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 預測則從原先的 2.8% 下修至 2.5%。這主要是受到東京政府實施公用事業補貼的影響，短期內減緩了通膨壓力。然而，日銀指出，隨著薪資與物價良性循環的維持，基調物價預計在 2026 年底至 2027 年度趨於 2% 的目標水準。
儘管本次維持利率不變，日銀強調若經濟與物價展望如期實現，將繼續提高政策利率，以調整金融寬鬆程度。日銀特別提到，日元貶值及 AI 帶動的半導體價格上漲，仍可能導致物價「上行風險」大於下行風險，甚至有超越 2% 目標的可能性。
市場分析師對此持鷹派解讀，凱投宏觀 (Capital Economics) 分析指出，日銀的評論暗示後續仍有升息可能，預測下一次行動可能落在 10 月，且利率有望在明年底達到 2%。日銀未來將密切關注中東局勢、匯率波動及 AI 產業動向，做為調整政策節奏的依據。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan decided to keep its policy interest rate unchanged at 1.0% with an overwhelming majority of 8 to 1 at its monetary policy meeting on Friday, reflecting its intention to observe the impact of its previous rate hike in June on the economy and prices, and to remain cautious about the Middle East conflict and yen exchange rate.
The decision led to a weakening of the yen, with the dollar-yen exchange rate rising 0.7% on Friday.

The only dissenter in the meeting was committee member Takashi Kadota, who proposed raising the interest rate to around 1.25%, citing the need for flexible policy adjustments as Japan enters a 'new phase' with increasing risks of higher prices at home and a shift in overseas monetary policies, but his proposal was rejected by the majority.

According to the 'Economic and Price Outlook' report released by the Bank of Japan at the same time, policymakers expect the increase in demand related to artificial intelligence (AI) and government subsidy policies to support domestic consumption in the 2026 fiscal year.

In terms of prices, the forecast for the core consumer price index (CPI) in the 2026 fiscal year was revised down from 2.8% to 2.5%, mainly due to the impact of the Tokyo government's implementation of public utility subsidies, which has eased inflationary pressure in the short term. However, the Bank of Japan pointed out that with the maintenance of a virtuous cycle of wages and prices, the underlying inflation rate is expected to approach the 2% target level by the end of 2026 to 2027.

Although the interest rate was left unchanged this time, the Bank of Japan emphasized that if the economic and price outlook is as expected, it will continue to raise policy interest rates to adjust the degree of monetary easing. The Bank of Japan particularly noted that the depreciation of the yen and the rise in semiconductor prices driven by AI may still lead to 'upside risks' to prices, even exceeding the 2% target.

Market analysts took a hawkish view of this, with Capital Economics analysts pointing out that the Bank of Japan's comments suggest that there is still a possibility of further rate hikes, predicting that the next action may come in October, and that interest rates are expected to reach 2% by the end of next year. The Bank of Japan will closely watch the situation in the Middle East, exchange rate fluctuations, and trends in the AI industry as the basis for adjusting the pace of policy.

items.title: 日元狂升500點是假反轉？美日匯市角力透露下一波行情關鍵
items.title_en: Is the 500-Point Surge in the Yen a False Reversal? The Struggle in the US-Japan Forex Market Reveals the Key to the Next Trend
paras: 就在日本央行週五 (31 日) 公布利率決議前夕，日元匯率出現劇烈反彈。市場消息顯示，日本當局可能在週四紐約交易時段再次出手干預外匯市場，而這次行動疑似獲得美國方面支持。
週四紐約交易時段，日元 / 美元 (JPYUSD) 一度急升逾 500 點，創下自 2023 年 12 月以來最大盤中漲幅。根據日本當地知情人士透露，此次干預目的在於提振日元匯率；與此同時，美國當局於東京時間凌晨 2 點 30 分左右進行「匯率詢價」（rate checks），此舉通常被市場視為美方可能準備介入匯市的前兆訊號。
市場人士認為，美方的相關行動提升了此次日本干預的市場影響力，也可能促使交易員在操作日元時更加謹慎。
美國財政部長斯貝森特週四受訪時表示，他認為日元「似乎被嚴重低估」，並指出匯率「過度波動」並不健康。
日本最高外匯官員三村淳週五被問及是否實施匯市干預時，並未正面回應，但表示日本從美國獲得的不僅僅是道義上的支持。
利率決議前夕精準狙擊
分析人士指出，日本此次選擇在日本央行貨幣政策會議前出手，可能是為了提高干預效果，並藉由突襲方式降低市場預期。
SMBC 日興證券高級外匯與利率策略師丸山凜斗（Rinto Maruyama）表示，在日本央行會議前進行干預，與今年 4 月較透明、容易被市場察覺的干預方式形成明顯差異。
他指出，近期日美兩國長期債券殖利率急升，是日本外匯干預以及美國匯率詢價行動背後的重要因素。另有分析認為，聯準會決議後美元指數意外走弱，也為日本當局進場干預創造較有利環境。
日元雖急升 貶值壓力仍未解除
在此次行情中，美元兌日元匯率一度跌至 157.98，亞洲時段最新交投約 160.67 附近。不過，儘管日元短線大幅反彈，過去 12 個月來日元兌美元仍累計貶值約 6%，在 G10 貨幣中表現墊底。
日本財務大臣片山皋月面對媒體詢問時表示，目前無法透露是否進行匯市干預，但重申當局持續保持高度警戒，隨時準備採取應對措施。
近幾個月來，日元持續承受貶值壓力，主要受到油價上漲、財政赤字，以及日美利率差擴大的影響。儘管日本當局上一季已在公開市場投入創紀錄的 11.73 兆日元（約 734 億美元）買入日元，但匯率仍持續走弱。
動用巨額資金救日元 挑戰全球匯市力量
根據日本財務省外匯儲備資料，日本先前可能動用了持有的外國證券，包括美國國債，作為干預匯市的資金來源。
這筆史無前例的資金規模，不僅凸顯日本面臨的匯率壓力，也反映出在全球每日交易規模達 9.5 兆美元的外匯市場中，單一國家想逆轉市場趨勢的難度。
利差問題未解 日元長線仍面臨考驗
日本自 2022 年重新重返外匯市場支撐日元後，並於 2024 年再次出手，試圖減緩日元兌美元貶值速度。日元長期走弱，主要源於全球央行在疫情後通膨升溫期間陸續升息，但日本央行長期維持負利率政策，以刺激經濟成長。
此次日元異動正值日本央行政策決議前夕，市場原先預期日本央行在上月升息後，將暫時維持利率不變。上月升息後，日本基準利率已升至 1995 年以來最高水準，投資人此前擔憂日本央行在應對通膨方面反應落後。
此外，儘管聯準會本週維持利率不變，市場仍預期今年稍晚可能降息，日美利率差距短期內仍可能維持對日元不利的格局。
對於此次干預效果，三井住友信託銀行紐約交易員山本武尊（Takeru Yamamoto）表示，當局此時出手可能讓外匯投資人重新評估風險，暫時降低拋售日元的意願。
paras_en: Just before the Bank of Japan's interest rate decision on Friday, the yen exchange rate experienced a sharp rebound. Market news showed that Japanese authorities may have intervened in the foreign exchange market again during the New York trading session on Thursday, and this action was suspected to have been supported by the US side.

During the New York trading session on Thursday, the yen/dollar (JPYUSD) once surged by more than 500 points, creating the largest intraday gain since December 2023. According to local informed sources in Japan, the purpose of this intervention was to boost the yen exchange rate; meanwhile, the US authorities conducted 'rate checks' around 2:30 am Tokyo time, which is usually seen by the market as a sign that the US may be preparing to intervene in the forex market.

Market participants believe that the US side's related actions have enhanced the market impact of Japan's intervention and may have prompted traders to be more cautious when operating the yen. US Treasury Secretary Spencent said in an interview on Thursday that he thought the yen was 'severely undervalued' and pointed out that excessive exchange rate fluctuations are unhealthy.

Japan's top foreign exchange official, Michinori Mochizuki, was asked on Friday whether forex intervention was implemented, but did not respond directly, saying that Japan had received more than just moral support from the US.

Analysts pointed out that Japan's choice to intervene before the Bank of Japan's monetary policy meeting may have been to increase the effectiveness of the intervention and reduce market expectations through a surprise attack.

Rinto Maruyama, senior forex and rates strategist at SMBC Nikko Securities, said that intervening before the Bank of Japan meeting was significantly different from the more transparent intervention method in April, which was easier for the market to detect.

He pointed out that the recent surge in long-term bond yields in Japan and the US was an important factor behind Japan's forex intervention and the US's rate check action. Another analysis suggested that the unexpected weakness in the US dollar index after the Fed's decision also created a more favorable environment for Japan's intervention.

Although the yen surged, the downward pressure on the currency has not been alleviated. In this trend, the dollar/yen exchange rate once fell to 157.98 and was recently trading around 160.67 in the Asian session. However, despite the yen's short-term sharp rebound, it has accumulated a depreciation of about 6% against the US dollar over the past 12 months, ranking last among G10 currencies.

Japanese Finance Minister Tsukasa Makishima said when facing media inquiries that he could not disclose whether forex intervention was conducted, but reiterated that the authorities remain highly vigilant and are ready to take countermeasures at any time.

In recent months, the yen has continued to face downward pressure, mainly due to rising oil prices, fiscal deficits, and the widening interest rate differential between Japan and the US. Although the Japanese authorities invested a record 1.173 trillion yen (approximately $7.34 billion) in the open market to buy yen last quarter, the exchange rate continued to weaken.

Using huge funds to save the yen challenges the global forex market's strength. According to the Japanese Ministry of Finance's foreign exchange reserve data, Japan may have used its holdings of foreign securities, including US Treasury bonds, as a funding source for intervening in the forex market.

This unprecedented scale of funds not only highlights the exchange rate pressure Japan faces but also reflects the difficulty for a single country to reverse market trends in the global forex market, where daily trading volume reaches $9.5 trillion.

The interest rate differential problem has not been resolved, and the yen still faces a long-term test. Japan has been back in the forex market to support the yen since 2022 and intervened again in 2024 to slow down the yen's depreciation against the US dollar. The yen's long-term weakness mainly stems from global central banks' rate hikes during the post-pandemic inflation period, while the Bank of Japan has maintained a negative interest rate policy to stimulate economic growth.

This yen fluctuation occurred just before the Bank of Japan's policy decision, and the market had initially expected the Bank of Japan to maintain interest rates unchanged after last month's rate hike. After the rate hike last month, Japan's benchmark interest rate has risen to its highest level since 1995, and investors had previously been concerned that the Bank of Japan was lagging behind in responding to inflation.

Additionally, although the Fed maintained interest rates this week, the market still expects a possible rate cut later this year, and the Japan-US interest rate differential may continue to be unfavorable to the yen in the short term.

Regarding the effect of this intervention, Takeru Yamamoto, a New York trader at Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, said that the authorities' intervention at this time may have prompted forex investors to reevaluate risks and temporarily reduced their willingness to sell the yen.

items.title: 韓日聯手干預匯率？韓元兌美元飆升至9個月新高 日元創兩年多單日最大升幅
items.title_en: South Korea and Japan Collaborate on Currency Intervention? Won Surges to 9-Month High Against USD, Yen Sees Largest Single-Day Gain in Over 2 Years
paras: 韓元兌美元匯率今 (31) 日早盤一度升值至九個月高點，此前首爾外匯當局疑似實施了匯率維穩操作。
首爾時間上午 6 點左右，韓元兌美元升值至 1418 韓元，創 2025 年 10 月 20 日以來的最高水準。截至當地時間今日上午 9 時 37 分，韓元兌美元報 1430 韓元。
韓元的升值與日元的上漲同步。在週四 (30 日) 紐約交易時段，日元兌美元匯率一度升值 3.3%，創下自 2023 年 12 月以來的最大盤中升幅紀錄。對此市場普遍猜測日本當局出手干預。
首爾 KB 國民銀行分析師 Lee Min-hyuk 表示，韓元與日元之間的相關性引發了外界猜測，兩國外匯監管機構可能已介入市場。
他並推測說：「韓元和日元隔夜走強「恐顯示韓日當局可能已共同干預」。
市場正屏息等待日本央行 (BOJ) 決議，總裁植田和男的記者會將決定日元這輪反彈是趨勢反轉，還是短暫脈衝。BOJ 預計維持政策利率在 1% 不變，決議可能獲得政策委員會廣泛多數支持。BOJ 也將發布季度展望報告，包含更新的經濟成長和通膨率估值，而受到日本國內活動韌性和 AI 相關投資的強勁需求支撐，決策官員可能上調日本成長預期，
日元大漲後，日本政府不願證實是否在隔夜交易期間干預匯市，但暗示得到了美國官員等海外同行的支持。
日本財務大臣片山皋月今日迴避日元飆升是否是干預結果的問題，僅稱將「保持高度警惕，並採取適當措施」。
隨後不久，日本外匯事務負責人三村淳暗示，一直得到美國同行和其他國家的支持。
三村淳說，「確實意識到，我們從美國獲得的支持不僅僅是道德上的支持」，並稱已透過個人管道與美國當局保持密切聯繫，但拒絕透露更多細節。
paras_en: The South Korean won (KRW) appreciated to a nine-month high against the US dollar in early trading today, following suspected intervention by Seoul's foreign exchange authorities. The won rose to 1,418 KRW per USD around 6:00 am local time, its highest level since October 20, 2025, and was trading at 1,430 KRW per USD as of 9:37 am local time.

The won's gain was synchronized with the yen's (JPY) surge. In Thursday's New York trading session, the yen appreciated 3.3% against the USD, marking its largest intraday gain since December 2023, sparking speculation about potential intervention by Japanese authorities.

Lee Min-hyuk, an analyst at KB Kookmin Bank in Seoul, stated that the correlation between the won and the yen has led to speculation about possible intervention by the foreign exchange authorities of both countries. He further speculated that the overnight strength of the won and the yen might indicate joint intervention by South Korean and Japanese authorities.

The market is eagerly awaiting the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) decision, with Governor Kazuo Ueda's press conference set to determine whether the yen's rebound is a trend reversal or a short-term pulse. The BOJ is expected to maintain its policy rate at 1%, with the decision likely to receive broad support from the policy committee. The BOJ will also release its quarterly outlook report, including updated estimates for economic growth and inflation, which may be revised upward due to strong domestic demand and AI-related investments.

Following the yen's significant surge, the Japanese government declined to confirm whether it had intervened in the currency market during overnight trading but hinted at receiving support from US officials and other overseas counterparts. Japanese Finance Minister Tsukasa Makishima avoided commenting on whether the yen's surge was a result of intervention, stating only that the government would 'remain highly vigilant and take appropriate measures'.

Soon after, Japan's foreign exchange chief, Junichi Suzuki, suggested that the country had received support from the US and other nations. Suzuki stated, 'We are aware that the support we receive from the US is not just moral support', and mentioned that Japan had maintained close contact with US authorities through personal channels, but refused to disclose further details.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】疑似日本干預，日圓升逾2%
